m.title: 诱导公式一的应用 · 讲义
m.body:
知识梳理

\(1\).诱导公式一
由三角函数的定义,可以知道\(:\)终边相同的角的同一三角函数值相等.
由此得到一组公式(公式一)\(:\)
\[\sin(\alpha+k\cdot2\pi)=\sin\alpha\]
\[\cos(\alpha+k\cdot2\pi)=\cos\alpha\]
\[\tan(\alpha+k\cdot2\pi)=\tan\alpha\]
其中\(k\in\mathbf{Z}\).
此公式也可以记为\(:\)
\(\sin(\alpha+k\cdot360^\circ)=\sin\alpha\),
\(\cos(\alpha+k\cdot360^\circ)=\cos\alpha\),
\(\tan(\alpha+k\cdot360^\circ)=\tan\alpha\),
其中\(k\in\mathbf{Z}\).
这组公式可以统一概括为\(f(a+k\cdot2\pi)=f(\alpha)(k\in\mathbf{Z})\)的形式,其特征是\(:\)等号两边是同名函数,且符号都为正.
 
\(2\).要注意诱导公式一的运用
\(①\)把负角或大于\(360^\circ\)的角转化为\(\alpha+k\cdot360^\circ(0^\circ\le\alpha<360^\circ)\)的形式,为利用诱导公式一做准备.
\(②\)先利用诱导公式一转化为特殊角的三角函数,再求解.
\(③\)利用诱导公式一可把负角的三角函数转化为\(0\sim2\pi\)内的角的三角函数,也可把大于\(2\pi\)的角的三角函数转化为\(0\sim2\pi\)内的角的三角函数,即实现了\(“\)负化正,大化小\(”\),要注意记忆特殊角的三角函数值.
 
\(3\).化简实际上是一种不指定答案的恒等变形,对化简的一般要求\(:\)\(①\)项数要最少\(;\)\(②\)次数要最低\(;\)\(③\)函数种类要最少\(;\)\(④\)分母不含根号\(;\)\(⑤\)能求值的要求值.

方法点拨

利用诱导公式一求解三角函数式的化简求值问题的步骤
 
先将相关角表示为\(\alpha+2k\pi\)或\(\alpha+k\cdot360^\circ(k\in\mathbf{Z})\)的形式,其中\(\alpha\in[0,2\pi)\)或\(0^\circ\le\alpha<360^\circ\),再利用公式一化简,最后利用特殊角的三角函数值求解.

小结

\(1\).诱导公式一的应用思路
(\(1\))诱导公式一的实质是终边相同的角的同名三角函数值相等.
(\(2\))利用诱导公式一可将负角或大于等于\(2\pi\)的角的三角函数化为\(0\sim 2\pi\)之间的角的同名三角函数,实现了\(“\)负化正,大化小\(”\).
 
\(2\).利用诱导公式一求解三角函数式的化简求值问题，除了要熟练运用公式外,还要准确记忆特殊角的三角函数值.
角\(\alpha\)\(0^\circ\)\(30^\circ\)\(45^\circ\)\(60^\circ\)\(90^\circ\)\(120^\circ\)\(150^\circ\)\(180^\circ\)\(270^\circ\)\(360^\circ\)
角\(\alpha\)的弧度数\(0\)\(\dfrac{\pi}{6}\)\(\dfrac{\pi}{4}\)\(\dfrac{\pi}{3}\)\(\dfrac{\pi}{2}\)\(\dfrac{2\pi}{3}\)\(\dfrac{5\pi}{6}\)\(\pi\)\(\dfrac{3\pi}{2}\)\(2\pi\)
\(\sin\alpha\)\(0\)\(\dfrac{1}{2}\)\(\dfrac{\sqrt{2}}{2}\)\(\dfrac{\sqrt{3}}{2}\)\(1\)\(\dfrac{\sqrt{3}}{2}\)\(\dfrac{1}{2}\)\(0\)\(-1\)\(0\)
\(\cos\alpha\)\(1\)\(\dfrac{\sqrt{3}}{2}\)\(\dfrac{\sqrt{2}}{2}\)\(\dfrac{1}{2}\)\(0\)\(-\dfrac{1}{2}\)\(-\dfrac{\sqrt{3}}{2}\)\(-1\)\(0\)\(1\)
\(\tan\alpha\)\(0\)\(\dfrac{\sqrt{3}}{3}\)\(1\)\(\sqrt{3}\)不存在\(-\sqrt{3}\)\(-\dfrac{\sqrt{3}}{3}\)\(0\)不存在\(0\)
 
\(3\).诱导公式一只能把大于\(360^\circ\)的角的三角函数转化为\(0^\circ\sim360^\circ\)的三角函数值,但要把它转化为锐角,有时还需要其他诱导公式,这些公式我们将在下一节学习.

q.stem:
(\(2024\)·重庆联考)
已知\({\alpha}\)是第二象限角\(,\sin{\alpha}=\dfrac{5}{13},\)则\(\cos{\alpha}=\) ____ .
q.analysis:
因为\({\alpha}\)是第二象限角\(,\)所以\(\cos{\alpha}<0,\)可排除选项\(C,D,\)

又\(\sin^2{\alpha}+\cos^2{\alpha}=1,\)所以排除选项\(B\).故选\(A\).

q.stem:
(\(2024\)·湖南联考)

已知\(\alpha\)是第二象限角，\({sin\alpha}={5\over13}\)，则\(cos\alpha=\)____
q.analysis: 因为\(\alpha\)是第二象限角，所以\(cos\alpha<0\)，又\(sin^2\alpha+cos^2\alpha=1\),所以\(cos\alpha=-\sqrt{1-sin^2\alpha}=-{12\over13}\).

q.stem: 已知\({\cos}{\alpha}=-\dfrac{3}{5}\)，\({\alpha}\)是第三象限的角，则\({\sin}{\alpha}=\) ____ .
q.analysis:
因为\({\alpha}\)是第三象限的角，

所以\({\sin}{\alpha}=-\sqrt{1-{\cos}^2{\alpha}}=-\dfrac{4}{5}\).

q.stem: 如果\({\sin}{\alpha}=-\dfrac{2}{3}\)，且\({\alpha}\)是第三象限的角，那么\({\tan}{\alpha}\)的值等于 ____ .
q.analysis:
因为\({\alpha}\)是第三象限的角，

所以\({\cos}{\alpha}=-\sqrt{1-{\sin}^2{\alpha}}=-\sqrt{1-(-\dfrac{2}{3})^2}=-\dfrac{\sqrt{5}}{3}\)，

所以\({\tan}{\alpha}=\dfrac{{\sin}{\alpha}}{{\cos}{\alpha}}=\dfrac{-\dfrac{2}{3}}{-\dfrac{\sqrt{5}}{3}}=\dfrac{2\sqrt{5}}{5}\).

q.stem: 已知角\({\alpha}\)是第二象限角，\({\tan}{\alpha}=-\dfrac{1}{2}\)，则\({\cos}{\alpha}=\) ________ .
q.analysis:
因为角\({\alpha}\)是第二象限角，

所以\({\cos}{\alpha}<0\).

由\({\sin}^2{\alpha}+{\cos}^2{\alpha}=1\)，\({\tan}{\alpha}=\dfrac{{\sin}{\alpha}}{{\cos}{\alpha}}=-\dfrac{1}{2}\)，

得\(\dfrac{1}{4}{\cos}^2{\alpha}+{\cos}^2{\alpha}=1\)，

所以\({\cos}{\alpha}=-\dfrac{2\sqrt{5}}{5}\)（正值舍去）.

q.stem: 已知\({\cos}{\alpha}=-\dfrac{8}{17}\)，求\({\sin}{\alpha}\)，\({\tan}{\alpha}\)的值.
q.analysis:
答案：

若角\({\alpha}\)是第二象限角，\({\sin}{\alpha}=\dfrac{15}{17}\)，\({\tan}{\alpha}=-\dfrac{15}{8}\)；

若角\({\alpha}\)是第三象限角，\({\sin}{\alpha}=-\dfrac{15}{17}\)，\({\tan}{\alpha}=\dfrac{15}{8}\).

解析：

\({\because}{\cos}{\alpha}=-\dfrac{8}{17}<0\)，

\({\therefore}\)角\({\alpha}\)是第二或第三象限角.

若角\({\alpha}\)是第二象限角，

则\({\sin}{\alpha}=\sqrt{1-{\cos}^2{\alpha}}=\sqrt{1-(-\dfrac{8}{17})^2}=\dfrac{15}{17}\)，\({\tan}{\alpha}=\dfrac{{\sin}{\alpha}}{{\cos}{\alpha}}=\dfrac{\dfrac{15}{17}}{-\dfrac{8}{17}}=-\dfrac{15}{8}\).

若角\({\alpha}\)是第三象限角，则\({\sin}{\alpha}=-\sqrt{1-{\cos}^2{\alpha}}=-\sqrt{1-(-\dfrac{8}{17})^2}=-\dfrac{15}{17}\)，\({\tan}{\alpha}=\dfrac{{\sin}{\alpha}}{{\cos}{\alpha}}=\dfrac{-\dfrac{15}{17}}{-\dfrac{8}{17}}=\dfrac{15}{8}\).

q.stem: 已知\(\sin{\alpha}=\dfrac{1}{4},\)且\({\alpha}\in (\dfrac{\pi }{2},\pi ),\)则\(\sin{\alpha}-2\cos^2{\alpha}=\) ________ .\((\)答案不要用带分数和小数表示\()\)
q.analysis: 由已知得\(\cos{\alpha}=-\sqrt{1-(\dfrac{1}{4})^2}=-\dfrac{\sqrt{15}}{4},\)所以\(\sin{\alpha}-2\cos^2{\alpha}=\dfrac{1}{4}-2\times(-\dfrac{\sqrt{15}}{4})^2=-\dfrac{13}{8}\).

q.stem:
(\(2024\)·四川联考)
已知角\({\alpha}\)的终边上一点\(P(m,\sqrt{3}),\)且\(\cos{\alpha}=\dfrac{\sqrt{10}}{4},\)求\(\sin{\alpha}=\) ________ \(,\tan{\alpha}=\) ________ .
q.analysis:
根据三角函数定义建立关于\(m\)的方程\(,\)求出\(m\)的值\(,\)然后再求其他三角函数值.

由题意得\(x=m,y=\sqrt{3},\)所以\(r=\left |OP \right |=\sqrt{m^2+3},\)

所以\(\cos{\alpha}=\dfrac{x}{r}=\dfrac{m}{\sqrt{m^2+3}}=\dfrac{\sqrt{10}}{4},\)

解得\(m=\sqrt{5}(负值舍去),\)则\(r=2\sqrt{2},\)

所以\(\sin{\alpha}=\dfrac{y}{r}=\dfrac{\sqrt{3}}{2\sqrt{2}}=\dfrac{\sqrt{6}}{4},\tan{\alpha}=\dfrac{y}{x}=\dfrac{\sqrt{3}}{\sqrt{5}}=\dfrac{\sqrt{15}}{5}\).

\({\because}{\sin}\theta=\dfrac{1}{3}\)，\(\theta{\in}(\dfrac{{\pi}}{2}\)，\({\pi})\)，

\({\therefore}{\cos}\theta=-\sqrt{1-{\sin}^2\theta}=-\dfrac{2\sqrt{2}}{3}\)，

则\({\tan}\theta=\dfrac{{\sin}\theta}{{\cos}\theta}=\dfrac{\dfrac{1}{3}}{-\dfrac{2\sqrt{2}}{3}}=-\dfrac{\sqrt{2}}{4}\)，

故选\(C\).

q.stem: 已知\(\sin\alpha =\dfrac{\sqrt{5}}{5}\)，则\(\sin^4\alpha-\cos^4\alpha \)的值为 ____
q.analysis:
\(\because \cos^2\alpha =1-\sin^2\alpha =1-\dfrac{1}{5}=\dfrac{4}{5}\)，

\(\therefore \sin^4\alpha -\cos^4\alpha =(\sin^2\alpha +\cos^2\alpha )(\sin^2\alpha -\cos^2\alpha )=\dfrac{1}{5}-\dfrac{4}{5}=-\dfrac{3}{5}\)

q.stem: 已知\({\sin}{\alpha}=\dfrac{12}{13}\)，且角\({\alpha}\)是第二象限角，则\({\cos}{\alpha}=\) ________ ，\({\tan}{\alpha}=\) ________ .（若答案不为整数且绝对值大于\(1\)，请用假分数形式表示）
q.analysis:
\({\because}{\sin}^2{\alpha}+{\cos}^2{\alpha}=1\)，

\({\therefore}{\cos}^2{\alpha}=1-{\sin}^2{\alpha}=1-(\dfrac{12}{13})^2=\dfrac{25}{169}\)，

又\({\because}\)角\({\alpha}\)是第二象限角，

\({\therefore}{\cos}{\alpha}<0\)，

\({\therefore}{\cos}{\alpha}=-\dfrac{5}{13}\)，

从而\({\tan}{\alpha}=\dfrac{{\sin}{\alpha}}{{\cos}{\alpha}}=-\dfrac{12}{5}\).

m.title: 同角三角函数的基本关系求值-已知某个三角函数值 · 讲义
m.body:
知识梳理

\(1\).同角三角函数的基本关系
基本关系式语言描述
平方关系\(\sin^2\alpha+\cos^2\alpha=1\)同一个角\(\alpha\)的正弦\(、\)余弦的平方和等于\(1\)
商数关系\(\dfrac{\sin\alpha}{\cos\alpha}=\tan\alpha(\cos\alpha\ne0)\)同一个角\(\alpha\)的正弦\(、\)余弦的商等于角\(\alpha\)的正切
 
\(2\).基本关系式的变形公式
\[\sin^2\alpha+\cos^2\alpha=1\Rightarrow\begin{cases}\sin^2\alpha=1-\cos^2\alpha,\\\cos^2\alpha=1-\sin^2\alpha,\\\sin\alpha=\pm\sqrt{1-\cos^2\alpha},\\cos\alpha=\pm\sqrt{1-\sin^2\alpha}, \\(\sin\alpha\pm\cos\alpha)^2=1\pm2\sin\alpha\cos\alpha. \end{cases}\]
\[\tan\alpha=\dfrac{\sin\alpha}{\cos\alpha}\Rightarrow\begin{cases}\sin\alpha=\tan\alpha\cos\alpha, \\\cos\alpha=\dfrac{\sin\alpha}{\tan\alpha}. \end{cases}\]
 
(\(3\))已知角的一个三角函数值求其余三角函数值
在应用平方关系时要注意,一定要看角的终边所在的象限是否给出.如果没有给出,要分情况讨论开方结果的正负.应用商的关系时,要看\(\tan\alpha\)是否有意义.

方法点拨

已知角\(\alpha\)的一个三角函数值求其余三角函数值的求解思路
 
(\(1\))已知角\(\alpha\)的正弦值或余弦值,求角\(\alpha\)的其他三角函数值时,要利用平方关系先求余弦值或正弦值,再利用商的关系求正切值.
(\(2\))已知角\(\alpha\)的正切值,求角\(\alpha\)的其他三角函数时,可利用方程组\(\begin{cases}\sin\alpha=\tan\alpha\cos\alpha, \\\sin^2\alpha+\cos^2\alpha=1 \end{cases}\)\((\alpha\ne\dfrac{\pi}{2}+k\pi\),\(k\in\mathbf{Z})\)来求\(\sin\alpha\)和\(\cos\alpha\),若解得的三角函数值有两个,则要由角\(\alpha\)的终边所在象限决定取舍.
(\(3\))特别注意\(:\)以上两种情况都出现了开方运算,一定要注意\(“\)正\(、\)负号\(”\)的选取,符号取决于角\(\alpha\)的范围(终边位置)因此在求值时要先判断角\(\alpha\)的终边位置,再判断值的符号.

方法点拨

已知一个角的某一个三角函数值,便可运用同角三角函数的基本关系式求出其他三角函数值.在求值时,确定角的终边的位置是关键.有时,由于角的终边位置不确定,解的情况可能不止一种.

小结

(\(1\))利用变形公式\(\cos\alpha=\pm\sqrt{1-\sin^2\alpha}\)或\(\sin\alpha=\pm\sqrt{1-\cos^2\alpha}\)时,应依据\(\alpha\)所在象限来确定等式右边的\(“+”\)或\(“-”\).
 
(\(2\))熟记下面几组\(“\)勾股数\(”\),有时可得到这类问题的\(“\)秒杀解\(”:\)\((3,4,5)\),\((5,12,13)\),\((7,24,25)\),\((8,15,17)\),\((1,1,\sqrt{2})\),\((1,\sqrt{3},2)\),\((1,2,\sqrt{5})\),\((1,3,\sqrt{10})\),\((1,7,5\sqrt{2})\).
 
(\(3\))注意\(“\)同角\(”\),这里\(“\)同角\(”\)有两层含义,一是\(“\)角相同\(”\),二是对\(“\)任意\(”\)一个角(在使函数有意义的前提下)关系式都成立,即与角的表达形式无关,如\(\sin^23\alpha+\cos^23\alpha=1\)成立,但是\(\sin^2\alpha+\cos^2\beta=1\)就不一定成立.
 
(\(4\))\(\sin^2\alpha\)是\((\sin\alpha)^2\)的简写,读作\(“\sin\alpha\)的平方\(”\),不能将\(\sin^2\alpha\)写成\(\sin\alpha^2\),前者是\(\alpha\)的正弦的平方,后者是\(\alpha^2\)的正弦,两者是不同的,要弄清它们的区别,并能正确书写.
 
(\(5\))注意同角三角函数的基本关系式都是对于使它们有意义的角而言的,\(\sin^2\alpha+\cos^2\alpha=1\)对一切\(\alpha\in\mathbf{R}\)恒成立,而\(\tan\alpha=\dfrac{\sin\alpha}{\cos\alpha}\)对\(\alpha\ne\dfrac{\pi}{2}+k\pi(k\in\mathbf{Z})\)成立.

q.stem:
已知\({\tan}{\alpha}=\dfrac{1}{3}\)，求下列各式的值.

\((1)\dfrac{{\sin}{\alpha}+3{\cos}{\alpha}}{{\sin}{\alpha}-{\cos}{\alpha}}=\) ________ ；

\((2){\cos}^2{\alpha}-2{\sin}{\alpha}{\cos}{\alpha}=\) ________ .

（本题共 2 个空，按顺序填写，中间用「|」隔开）
q.analysis:
\((1)\)原式\(=\dfrac{{\tan}{\alpha}+3}{{\tan}{\alpha}-1}\)，把\({\tan}{\alpha}=\dfrac{1}{3}\)代入，

得原式\(=\dfrac{\dfrac{1}{3}+3}{\dfrac{1}{3}-1}=-5\).

\((2)\)原式\(=\dfrac{{\cos}^2{\alpha}-2{\sin}{\alpha}{\cos}{\alpha}}{{\sin}^2{\alpha}+{\cos}^2{\alpha}}=\dfrac{1-2{\tan}{\alpha}}{{\tan}^2{\alpha}+1}\)，把\({\tan}{\alpha}=\dfrac{1}{3}\)代入，

得原式\(=\dfrac{1-2{\times}\dfrac{1}{3}}{(\dfrac{1}{3})^2+1}=\dfrac{3}{10}\).

q.stem:
已知\(\tan{\alpha}=2,\)则
\((1)\)\(\dfrac{2\sin{\alpha}-3\cos{\alpha}}{4\sin{\alpha}-9\cos{\alpha}}=\) ________ \(;\)
\((2)\)\(\dfrac{2\sin^2{\alpha}-3\cos^2{\alpha}}{4\sin^2{\alpha}-9\cos^2{\alpha}}=\) ________ \(;\)
\((3)\)\(4\sin^2{\alpha}-3\sin{\alpha}\cos{\alpha}-5\cos^2{\alpha}=\) ________ .
（本题共 3 个空，按顺序填写，中间用「|」隔开）
q.analysis:
\((1)\)注意到分式的分子和分母均是关于\(\sin{\alpha},\cos{\alpha}\)的一次齐次式\(,\)由题意得\(\cos{\alpha}\neq 0,\)所以可将分子\(、\)分母同时除以\(\cos{\alpha},\)然后整体代入\(\tan{\alpha}=2\)求值.

\(\dfrac{2\sin{\alpha}-3\cos{\alpha}}{4\sin{\alpha}-9\cos{\alpha}}=\dfrac{2\tan{\alpha}-3}{4\tan{\alpha}-9}=\dfrac{2\times2-3}{4\times2-9}=-1\).

\((2)\)注意到分式的分子和分母均是关于\(\sin{\alpha},\cos{\alpha}\)的二次齐次式\(,\)因为\(\cos^2{\alpha}\neq 0,\)所以分子\(、\)分母可同时除以\(\cos^2{\alpha},\)则\(\dfrac{2\sin^2{\alpha}-3\cos^2{\alpha}}{4\sin^2{\alpha}-9\cos^2{\alpha}}=\dfrac{2\tan^2{\alpha}-3}{4\tan^2{\alpha}-9}=\dfrac{2\times4-3}{4\times4-9}=\dfrac{5}{7}\).

\((3)\)因为\(\sin^2{\alpha}+\cos^2{\alpha}=1,\)则有\(4\sin^2{\alpha}-3\sin{\alpha}\cos{\alpha}-5\cos^2{\alpha}\)\(=\dfrac{4\sin^2{\alpha}-3\sin{\alpha}\cos{\alpha}-5\cos^2{\alpha}}{1}\)\(=\dfrac{4\sin^2{\alpha}-3\sin{\alpha}\cos{\alpha}-5\cos^2{\alpha}}{\sin^2{\alpha}+\cos^2{\alpha}},\)这样便使得分子\(、\)分母均为二次齐次式.

同\((2)\)有\(\dfrac{4\sin^2{\alpha}-3\sin{\alpha}\cos{\alpha}-5\cos^2{\alpha}}{\sin^2{\alpha}+\cos^2{\alpha}}=\dfrac{4\tan^2{\alpha}-3\tan{\alpha}-5}{\tan^2{\alpha}+1}=\dfrac{4\times4-3\times2-5}{4+1}=1\).

q.stem:
已知\(\dfrac{{\sin}{\alpha}+{\cos}{\alpha}}{{\sin}{\alpha}-{\cos}{\alpha}}=2\)，计算下列各式的值.

\((1)\dfrac{3{\sin}{\alpha}-{\cos}{\alpha}}{2{\sin}{\alpha}+3{\cos}{\alpha}}=\) ________ ；

\((2){\sin}^2{\alpha}-2{\sin}{\alpha}{\cos}{\alpha}+1=\) ________ .

（本题共 2 个空，按顺序填写，中间用「|」隔开）
q.analysis:
由\(\dfrac{{\sin}{\alpha}+{\cos}{\alpha}}{{\sin}{\alpha}-{\cos}{\alpha}}=2\)，

化简得\({\sin}{\alpha}=3{\cos}{\alpha}\)，

所以\({\tan}{\alpha}=3\).

\((1)\)原式\(=\dfrac{3{\tan}{\alpha}-1}{2{\tan}{\alpha}+3}\)，

把\({\tan}{\alpha}=3\)代入，得原式\(=\dfrac{3{\times}3-1}{2{\times}3+3}=\dfrac{8}{9}\).

\((2)\)原式\(=\dfrac{{\sin}^2{\alpha}-2{\sin}{\alpha}{\cos}{\alpha}}{{\sin}^2{\alpha}+{\cos}^2{\alpha}}+1=\dfrac{{\tan}^2{\alpha}-2{\tan}{\alpha}}{{\tan}^2{\alpha}+1}+1\)，

把\({\tan}{\alpha}=3\)代入，得原式\(=\dfrac{3^2-2{\times}3}{3^2+1}+1=\dfrac{13}{10}\).

q.stem: 已知\(P(-\sqrt{3},y)\)为角\(\beta \)的终边上的一点\(,\)且\(\sin\beta =\dfrac{\sqrt{13}}{13},\)则\(\dfrac{2\sin^2\beta }{\sin^2\beta-\cos^2{\beta} }=\) ____ .
q.analysis: 因为\(\left |OP \right |=\sqrt{3+y^2}(O\)为坐标原点\(),\)故由正弦函数的定义可得\(\dfrac{y}{\sqrt{3+y^2}}=\dfrac{\sqrt{13}}{13},\)解得\(y=\dfrac{1}{2}\)或\(y=-\dfrac{1}{2}(\)舍去\()\).所以\(\tan\beta =\dfrac{\dfrac{1}{2}}{-\sqrt{3}}=-\dfrac{\sqrt{3}}{6},\)所以\(\dfrac{2\sin^2\beta }{\sin^2\beta-\cos^2{\beta} }=\dfrac{2\tan^2\beta}{\tan^2\beta-1}=\dfrac{2\times(-\dfrac{\sqrt{3}}{6})^2}{(-\dfrac{\sqrt{3}}{6})^2-1}=-\dfrac{2}{11},\)故选\(B\).

q.stem:
已知\(tan\alpha=2\),则

\((1)\)\({2sin\alpha-3cos\alpha\over4sin\alpha-9cos\alpha}=\)________

\((2)\)\({2sin^2\alpha-3cos^2\alpha\over4sin^2\alpha-9cos^2\alpha}=\)________

\((3)\)\(4sin^2\alpha-3sin\alpha cos\alpha-5cos^2\alpha=\)________
q.analysis:
\((1)\)注意到分式的分子和分母均是关于\(sin\alpha,cos\alpha\)的一次齐次式，由题意得\(cos\alpha\not=0\),所以可将分子分母同时除以\(cos\alpha\),然后整体代入\(tan\alpha=2\)的值.

\({2sin\alpha-3cos\alpha\over4sin\alpha-9cos\alpha}={2tan\alpha-3\over4tan\alpha-9}={2\times2-3\over4\times2-9}=-1\).

\((2)\)注意到分式的分子和分母均是关于\(sin\alpha,cos\alpha\)的二次齐次式，由题意得\(cos^2\alpha\not=0\),所以可将分子分母同时除以\(cos^2\alpha\),则

\({2sin^2\alpha-3cos^2\alpha\over4sin^2\alpha-9cos^2\alpha}={2tan^2\alpha-3\over4tan^2\alpha-9}={2\times4-3\over4\times4-9}={5\over7}\).

\((3)\)似乎跟前面两题没什么联系，但若能注意到\(sin^2\alpha+cos^2\alpha=1\),则有\(4sin^2\alpha-3sin\alpha cos\alpha-5cos^2\alpha={4sin^2\alpha-3sin\alpha cos\alpha-5cos^2\alpha\over1}={4sin^2\alpha-3sin\alpha cos\alpha-5cos^2\alpha\over sin^2\alpha+cos^2\alpha}\),这样便使得分子分母均为二次齐次式.同\((2)\)有\({4sin^2\alpha-3sin\alpha cos\alpha-5cos^2\alpha\over sin^2\alpha+cos^2\alpha}={4tan^2\alpha-3tan\alpha-5\over tan^2\alpha+1}={4\times4-3\times2-5\over4+1}=1.\)

q.stem: 已知\(tan\alpha=-\dfrac12\),则\(\dfrac{1 + 2sin\alpha cos\alpha}{sin^2\alpha-cos^2\alpha}\)的值是 ____ .
q.analysis:
\(\dfrac{1+2sin\alpha cos\alpha}{sin^2\alpha- cos^2\alpha}\)
\(=\dfrac{( sin\alpha+cos\alpha)^2}{(sin\alpha+cos \alpha)(sin\alpha-cos\alpha)}\)

\(=\dfrac{sin \alpha+cos\alpha}{sin\alpha-cos\alpha}=\dfrac{tan\alpha+1}{tan\alpha-1}\),

把\(tan\alpha=-\dfrac12\)代入,

得原式\(=\dfrac{-\dfrac12+1}{-\dfrac12-1}=-\dfrac13\).

q.stem: 如果\(tan\theta=2,\)那么\(1+sin\theta cos\theta=\)____.
q.analysis:
方法一  \(1+sin\theta cos\theta={1+sin\theta cos\theta\over1}={sin^2\theta+cos^2\theta+sin\theta cos\theta
\over sin^2\theta+cos^2\theta}={tan^2\theta+tan\theta+1\over tan^2\theta+1.}\)
又\(tan\theta=2,\)所以\(1+sin\theta cos\theta={2^2+2+1\over2^2+1}={7\over5}.\)
方法二  \(tan\theta=2,\)即\(sin\theta=2cos\theta,\)又\(sin^2\theta+cos^2\theta=1,\)
所以\((2cos\theta)^2+cos^2\theta=1,\)所以\(cos^2\theta={1\over5}.\)
又\(tan\theta=2>0,\)所以\(\theta\)为第一或第三象限角.
当\(\theta\)为第一象限角时,\(cos\theta={\sqrt{5}\over5},\)
此时\(sin\theta=\sqrt{1-cos^2\theta}={2\sqrt{5}\over5},\)
则\(1+sin\theta cos\theta=1+{2\sqrt{5}\over5}\times{\sqrt{5}\over5}={7\over5};\)
当\(\theta\)为第三象限角时,\(cos\theta=-{\sqrt{5}\over5},\)
此时\(sin\theta=-\sqrt{1-cos^2\theta}=-{2\sqrt{5}\over5},\)
则\(1+sin\theta cos\theta=1+(-{2\sqrt{5}\over5})\times(-{\sqrt{5}\over5})={7\over5}.\)

q.stem:
已知\({\tan}{\alpha}=\dfrac{1}{3}\)，求下列各式的值.

\((1)\dfrac{{\sin}{\alpha}+3{\cos}{\alpha}}{{\sin}{\alpha}-{\cos}{\alpha}}=\) ________ ；

\((2){\cos}^2{\alpha}-2{\sin}{\alpha}{\cos}{\alpha}=\) ________ .
q.analysis:
\((1)\)原式\(=\dfrac{{\tan}{\alpha}+3}{{\tan}{\alpha}-1}\)，把\({\tan}{\alpha}=\dfrac{1}{3}\)代入，

得原式\(=\dfrac{\dfrac{1}{3}+3}{\dfrac{1}{3}-1}=-5\).

\((2)\)原式\(=\dfrac{{\cos}^2{\alpha}-2{\sin}{\alpha}{\cos}{\alpha}}{{\sin}^2{\alpha}+{\cos}^2{\alpha}}=\dfrac{1-2{\tan}{\alpha}}{{\tan}^2{\alpha}+1}\)，把\({\tan}{\alpha}=\dfrac{1}{3}\)代入，

得原式\(=\dfrac{1-2{\times}\dfrac{1}{3}}{(\dfrac{1}{3})^2+1}=\dfrac{3}{10}\).

q.stem: 已知\({sin\alpha-2cos\alpha\over3sin\alpha+5cos\alpha}=-5,\)那么\(tan\alpha=\)________.
q.analysis:
易知\(cos\alpha\not=0,\)由\({sin\alpha-2cos\alpha\over3sin\alpha+5cos\alpha}=-5,\)得
\({tan\alpha-2\over3tan\alpha+5}=-5,\)解得\(tan\alpha=-{23\over16}\).

q.stem: 已知\(\sin\theta +3\cos\theta =0\),则\(\cos^2\theta -\sin^2\theta =\) ________ .
q.analysis: 由\(\sin\theta +3\cos\theta =0\)得\(\tan\theta =-3\),所以\(\cos^2\theta -\sin^2\theta =\dfrac{\cos^2\theta-\sin^2\theta}{\cos^2\theta+\sin^2\theta}=\dfrac{1-\tan^2\theta}{1+\tan^2\theta}=\dfrac{1-(-3)^2}{1+(-3)^2}=-\dfrac{4}{5}\).

m.title: 同角三角函数的基本关系求值-tanα · 讲义
m.body:
知识梳理

\(1\).同角三角函数的基本关系
基本关系式语言描述
平方关系\(\sin^2\alpha+\cos^2\alpha=1\)同一个角\(\alpha\)的正弦\(、\)余弦的平方和等于\(1\)
商数关系\(\dfrac{\sin\alpha}{\cos\alpha}=\tan\alpha(\cos\alpha\ne0)\)同一个角\(\alpha\)的正弦\(、\)余弦的商等于角\(\alpha\)的正切
 \(2\).基本关系式的变形公式
\[\sin^2\alpha+\cos^2\alpha=1\Rightarrow\begin{cases}\sin^2\alpha=1-\cos^2\alpha,\\\cos^2\alpha=1-\sin^2\alpha,\\\sin\alpha=\pm\sqrt{1-\cos^2\alpha},\\cos\alpha=\pm\sqrt{1-\sin^2\alpha}, \\(\sin\alpha\pm\cos\alpha)^2=1\pm2\sin\alpha\cos\alpha. \end{cases}\]
\[\tan\alpha=\dfrac{\sin\alpha}{\cos\alpha}\Rightarrow\begin{cases}\sin\alpha=\tan\alpha\cos\alpha, \\\cos\alpha=\dfrac{\sin\alpha}{\tan\alpha}. \end{cases}\]
 
(\(3\))由\(\tan\alpha\)求关于\(\sin\alpha\)和\(\cos\alpha\)的齐次式的值
已知角\(\alpha\)的正切值求由\(\sin\alpha\),\(\cos\alpha\)构成的代数式的值的题主要涉及两种题型,一是代数式是分式的形式,另一类是代数式是整式的形式.

方法点拨

灵活利用\(“1”\)的代换,将整式变为分式,即利用分式的性质将式子变为关于\(\tan\alpha\)的代数式,从而代入求值.\(“1”\)的代换是三角恒等变换思想之一,它是三角恒等交换\(“\)常值代换\(”\)的特殊表现.所谓\(“\)常值代换\(”\)就是根据需要将某些常数用其特殊三角函数值代换,如\(\sqrt{3}=\tan\dfrac{\pi}{3}\)等.

小结

已知角\(\alpha\)的正切值求由\(\sin\alpha\)和\(\cos\alpha\)构成的代数式的值的方法
 
(\(1\))形如\(\dfrac{a\sin\alpha+b\cos\alpha}{c\sin\alpha+d\cos\alpha}\)的分式,可将分子\(、\)分母同时除以\(\cos\alpha;\)形如\(\dfrac{a\sin^2\alpha+b\sin\alpha\cos\alpha+c\cos^2\alpha}{d\sin^2\alpha+e\sin\alpha\cos\alpha+f\cos^\alpha}\)的分式,可将分子\(、\)分母同时除以\(\cos^2\alpha\),将含正\(、\)余弦的项转化为含正切的项或常数项,从而求值.
 
(\(2\))形如\(a\sin^2\alpha+b\sin\alpha\cos\alpha+c\cos^2\alpha\)的式子,可将其看成分母为\(1\)的分式,再将分母\(1\)变形为\(\sin^2\alpha+\cos^2\alpha\),转化为形如\(\dfrac{a\sin^2\alpha+b\sin\alpha\cos\alpha+c\cos^2\alpha}{\sin^2\alpha+\cos^2\alpha}\)的分式,然后利用弦化切求解.

q.stem:
\((2024\)·山东潍坊\()\)
已知\(\cos{\alpha}+\sin{\alpha}=-\dfrac{1}{2},\)则\( \sin{\alpha}\cos{\alpha}\)的值为 ____ .
q.analysis: 由已知得\((\cos{\alpha}+\sin{\alpha})^2\)\(=\sin^2{\alpha}+\cos^2{\alpha}+2\sin{\alpha}\cos{\alpha}\)\(=1+2\sin{\alpha}\cos{\alpha}=\)\(\dfrac{1}{4},解得\sin{\alpha}\cos{\alpha}=-\dfrac{3}{8}\).

q.stem:
\((2024\cdot山东省潍坊\)
已知\(cos\alpha+sin\alpha=-{1\over2}\),则\(sin\alpha cos\alpha\)的值为____.
q.analysis:
由已知得\((cos\alpha+sin\alpha)^2=sin^2\alpha+cos^2\alpha+2sin\alpha cos\alpha=1+2sin\alpha cos\alpha={1\over4}\),解得
\(sin\alpha cos\alpha=-{3\over8}\).

\({\because}{\sin}{\alpha}+{\cos}{\alpha}=\dfrac{1}{3}\)，\(①\)

将其两边同时平方，得\(1+2{\sin}{\alpha}{\cos}{\alpha}=\dfrac{1}{9}\)，

\({\therefore}2{\sin}{\alpha}{\cos}{\alpha}=-\dfrac{8}{9}\).

\({\because}{\alpha}{\in}(0\)，\({\pi})\)，

\({\therefore}{\cos}{\alpha}<0<{\sin}{\alpha}\).

\({\because}({\sin}{\alpha}-{\cos}{\alpha})^2=1-2{\sin}{\alpha}{\cos}{\alpha}=\dfrac{17}{9}\)，

\({\therefore}{\sin}{\alpha}-{\cos}{\alpha}=\dfrac{\sqrt{17}}{3}\).\(②\)

由\(①②\)得\({\sin}{\alpha}=\dfrac{1+\sqrt{17}}{6}\)，\({\cos}{\alpha}=\dfrac{1-\sqrt{17}}{6}\).

\({\therefore}{\tan}{\alpha}=\dfrac{{\sin}{\alpha}}{{\cos}{\alpha}}=-\dfrac{9+\sqrt{17}}{8}\).

q.stem:
已知\({\sin}\theta+{\cos}\theta=\dfrac{1}{5}\)，\(\theta{\in}(0\)，\({\pi})\)，求下列各式的值.

\((1){\sin}\theta=\) ________ ，\({\cos}\theta=\) ________ ，\({\tan}\theta=\) ________ ；

\((2){\sin}\theta-{\cos}\theta=\) ________ ；

\((3){\sin}^3\theta+{\cos}^3\theta=\) ________ .

（本题共 5 个空，按顺序填写，中间用「|」隔开）
q.analysis:
\((1){\because}{\sin}\theta+{\cos}\theta=\dfrac{1}{5}\)，\(\theta{\in}(0\)，\({\pi})\)，

\({\therefore}1+2{\sin}\theta{\cos}\theta=\dfrac{1}{25}\)，

\({\therefore}2{\sin}\theta{\cos}\theta=-\dfrac{24}{25}<0\).

\({\therefore}2{\sin}\theta(\dfrac{1}{5}-{\sin}\theta)=-\dfrac{24}{25}\)，

又\(\theta{\in}(0\)，\({\pi})\)，

\({\therefore}{\sin}\theta>0\)，\({\cos}\theta<0\).

解得\({\sin}\theta=\dfrac{4}{5}\)（负值舍去），

\({\therefore}{\cos}\theta=-\sqrt{1-{\sin}^2\theta}=-\sqrt{1-(\dfrac{4}{5})^2}=-\dfrac{3}{5}\).

\({\therefore}{\tan}\theta=\dfrac{{\sin}\theta}{{\cos}\theta}=\dfrac{\dfrac{4}{5}}{-\dfrac{3}{5}}=-\dfrac{4}{3}\).

\((2){\sin}\theta-{\cos}\theta=\dfrac{4}{5}-(-\dfrac{3}{5})=\dfrac{7}{5}\).

\((3){\because}{\sin}^3\theta+{\cos}^3\theta\)

\(=({\sin}\theta+{\cos}\theta)({\sin}^2\theta+{\cos}^2\theta-{\sin}\theta{\cos}\theta)\)

\(=({\sin}\theta+{\cos}\theta)(1-{\sin}\theta{\cos}\theta)\)，

\({\therefore}{\sin}^3\theta+{\cos}^3\theta=\dfrac{1}{5}{\times}(1+\dfrac{12}{25})=\dfrac{37}{125}\).

q.stem: 从已知条件\(sin\theta+cos\theta={1\over5}\),且\(\theta\in(0,\pi)\)可以得到那些结论？
q.analysis:
答案：

\(①\)\(sin\theta cos\theta=-{12\over25}\)

\(②\)\((sin\theta-cos\theta)^2={49\over25}\)

\(③\)\(sin\theta-cos\theta={7\over5}\)

\(④\)\(sin\theta={4\over5},cos\theta=-{3\over5}\)

\(⑤\)\(tan\theta=-{4\over3}\)

解析：

本题的结论是开放的.由\(sin\theta+cos\theta={1\over5}\)可以得出的结论是多样的，为此需明确方向.从同角三角函数的关系入手.

因为\(sin\theta+cos\theta={1\over5}\),

所以\((sin\theta+cos\theta)^2={1\over25}\),

即\(sin^2\theta+cos^2\theta+2sin\theta cos\theta={1\over25}\),

所以得\(sin\theta cos\theta=-{12\over25}\)\(①\);

因为\((sin\theta-cos\theta)^2=(sin\theta+cos\theta)^2-4sin\theta cos\theta\),\((sin\theta-cos\theta)^2={49\over25}\)\(②\);

由\(sin\theta cos\theta=-{12\over25}<0,\)且\(\theta\in(0,\pi)\),可知\(\theta\in({\pi\over2},\pi)\),从而\(sin\theta-cos\theta={7\over5}\)\(③\);

将结论\(③\)与条件联立得\(sin\theta={4\over5},cos\theta=-{3\over5}\)\(④\);

由结论\(④\)可得\(tan\theta=-{4\over3}\)\(⑤\).

q.stem: 已知\(\left |\cos\theta \right |=-\cos\theta\)且\(\tan\theta<0,\)则代数式\(\lg{(\sin\theta-\cos\theta)}\) ________ \(0\).\((\)填\(“>”\)或\(“<”)\)
q.analysis:
由\(\left | \cos\theta\right |=-\cos\theta,\)得\(\cos\theta\leq 0\).

又\(\because\)\(\tan\theta<0,\)

\(\therefore\)角\({\theta}\)的终边在第二象限.

\(\therefore\)\(\sin\theta>0,\cos\theta<0,\)

\(\therefore\)\(\sin\theta-\cos\theta=\sqrt{1-2\sin\theta\cos\theta}>1, \)

\(\therefore\)\(\lg(\sin {\theta}-\cos{\theta})>0\).

q.stem:
(\(2024\)·江苏)
已知\(\sin\theta+\cos\theta=\dfrac{4}{3},\)且\(0<\theta<\dfrac{\pi }{4},\)则\(\sin\theta-\cos\theta\)的值为 ____ .
q.analysis:
\(\because\)\(\sin\theta+ \cos\theta=\dfrac{4}{3},\)

\(\therefore\)\(1+2\sin\theta \cos\theta=\dfrac{16}{9},\)

\(\therefore\)\(2\sin\theta \cos\theta=\dfrac{7}{9}\).

又\(0<\theta<\dfrac{\pi }{4},\)

\(\therefore\)\(\sin\theta- \cos\theta<0,\)

\(\therefore\)\(\sin\theta-\cos\theta=-\sqrt{(\sin\theta-\cos\theta)^2}=-\sqrt{1-2\sin\theta \cos\theta}=-\dfrac{\sqrt{2}}{3},\)故选\(B\).

q.stem: 已知\(sin\alpha cos\alpha={1\over8},\)且\(\pi<\alpha<{5\pi\over4},\)则\(cos\alpha-sin\alpha=\)________.
q.analysis:
因为\(\pi<\alpha<{5\pi\over4},\)所以\(cos\alpha<0,sin\alpha<0.\)利用三角函数线,知\(cos\alpha<sin\alpha
,\)所以\(cos\alpha-sin\alpha<0,\)所以\(cos\alpha-sin\alpha=-\sqrt{(cos\alpha-sin\alpha)^2}=-\sqrt{1-2
\times{1\over8}}=-{\sqrt{3}\over2}.\)

q.stem:
\((1)\)已知\(\sin{\alpha}+\cos{\alpha}=\sqrt{2},\)则\(\sin{\alpha}\cos{\alpha}=\) ________ ，\(sin^4{\alpha}+\cos^4{\alpha}=\) ________ \(;\)

\((2)\)已知\(\sin{\alpha}+\cos{\alpha}=\dfrac{1}{3}(0<{\alpha}<\pi ),\)则\(\sin{\alpha}-\cos{\alpha}=\) ________ .
q.analysis:
\((1)\)\(\because\)\(\sin{\alpha}+\cos{\alpha}=\sqrt{2},\)

\(\therefore\)\((\sin{\alpha}+\cos{\alpha})^2=\sin^2{\alpha}+\cos^2{\alpha}+2\sin{\alpha}\cos{\alpha}=1+2\sin{\alpha}\cos{\alpha}=2,\)

解得\(\sin{\alpha}\cos{\alpha}=\dfrac{1}{2},\)

\(\sin^4{\alpha}+\cos^4{\alpha}=(\sin^2{\alpha} +\cos^2{\alpha})^2-2\sin^2{\alpha}\cos^2{\alpha}=1-2\times\dfrac{1}{4}=\dfrac{1}{2}\).

\((2)\)\(\because\)\(\sin{\alpha}+\cos{\alpha}=\dfrac{1}{3}(0<{\alpha}<\pi ),\) 

\(\therefore\)\((\sin{\alpha}+\cos{\alpha})^2=1+2\sin{\alpha}\cos{\alpha}=\dfrac{1}{9},\)

\(\therefore\)\(2\sin{\alpha}\cos{\alpha}=-\dfrac{8}{9}\).

\(\therefore\)\((\sin{\alpha}-\cos{\alpha})^2=1-2\sin{\alpha}\cos{\alpha}=1+\dfrac{8}{9}=\dfrac{17}{9},\)

\(\because\)\(0<{\alpha}<\pi ,2\sin{\alpha}\cos{\alpha}=-\dfrac{8}{9},\)

\(\therefore\)\(\sin{\alpha} >0,\cos{\alpha}<0,\)

\(\therefore\)\(\sin{\alpha}-\cos{\alpha}=\sqrt{\dfrac{17}{9}}=\dfrac{\sqrt{17}}{3}\).

q.stem: 已知\(sin\theta+cos\theta=-{\sqrt{10}\over5},\)求\({1\over sin\theta}+{1\over cos\theta}=\)________,\(tan\theta=\)________.
q.analysis:
\((1)\)因为\(sin\theta+cos\theta=-{\sqrt{10}\over5},\)
所以\(1+2sin\theta cos\theta={2\over5},\)即\(sin\theta cos\theta=-{3\over10},\)
所以\({1\over sin\theta}+{1\over cos\theta}={cos\theta+sin\theta\over sin\theta cos\theta}={2\sqrt{10}\over3}.\)
\((2)\)由\((1)\)得\({sin^2\theta+cos^2\theta\over sin\theta cos\theta}=-{10\over3},\)
所以\({tan^2\theta+1\over tan\theta}=-{10\over3},\)即\(3tan^2\theta+10tan\theta+3=0,\)
所以\(tan\theta=-3\)或\(tan\theta=-{1\over3}.\)

q.stem: 若\(\sin{\alpha}+\cos{\alpha}=1,\)则\(\sin^n{\alpha}+\cos^n{\alpha}(n\in \mathbf Z)\)的值为 ________ .
q.analysis:
\(\because\)\(\sin{\alpha}+\cos{\alpha}=1,\)

\(\therefore\)\((\sin{\alpha}+\cos{\alpha})^2=1\).

又\(\because\)\(\sin^2{\alpha}+\cos^2{\alpha}=1,\)

\(\therefore\)\(\sin{\alpha}\cos{\alpha}=0,\)

\(\therefore\)\(\sin{\alpha}=0\)或\(\cos{\alpha}=0\).

当\(\sin{\alpha}=0\)时\(,\cos{\alpha}=1,\)此时有\(\sin^n{\alpha}+\cos^n{\alpha}=1;\)

当\(\cos{\alpha}=0\)时\(,\sin{\alpha}=1,\)此时也有\(\sin^n{\alpha}+\cos^n{\alpha}=1\).

\(\therefore\)\(\sin^n{\alpha}+\cos^n{\alpha}=1\).

m.title: 同角三角函数的基本关系求值-sinα±cosα与sinαcosα · 讲义
m.body:
知识梳理

\(1\).同角三角函数的基本关系
基本关系式语言描述
平方关系\(\sin^2\alpha+\cos^2\alpha=1\)同一个角\(\alpha\)的正弦\(、\)余弦的平方和等于\(1\)
商数关系\(\dfrac{\sin\alpha}{\cos\alpha}=\tan\alpha(\cos\alpha\ne0)\)同一个角\(\alpha\)的正弦\(、\)余弦的商等于角\(\alpha\)的正切
 
 \(2\).基本关系式的变形公式
\[\sin^2\alpha+\cos^2\alpha=1\Rightarrow\begin{cases}\sin^2\alpha=1-\cos^2\alpha,\\\cos^2\alpha=1-\sin^2\alpha,\\\sin\alpha=\pm\sqrt{1-\cos^2\alpha},\\cos\alpha=\pm\sqrt{1-\sin^2\alpha}, \\(\sin\alpha\pm\cos\alpha)^2=1\pm2\sin\alpha\cos\alpha. \end{cases}\]\[\tan\alpha=\dfrac{\sin\alpha}{\cos\alpha}\Rightarrow\begin{cases}\sin\alpha=\tan\alpha\cos\alpha, \\\cos\alpha=\dfrac{\sin\alpha}{\tan\alpha}. \end{cases}\]

\(3\).利用\(\sin\theta\pm\cos\theta\)与\(\sin\theta\cos\theta\)之间的关系求值
由\((\sin\theta+\cos\theta)^2=1+2\sin\theta\cos\theta\),\((\sin\theta-\cos\theta)^2=1-2\sin\theta\cos\theta\),可知\(:\)已知\(\sin\theta+\cos\theta\),\(\sin\theta-\cos\theta\),\(\sin\theta\cos\theta\)三个式子中任何一个的值,均可以求出另外两个式子的值.

方法点拨

在解三角函数问题时,要注意题目中的隐含条件.本题若灵活运用\(\sin^2\alpha+\cos^2\alpha=1\),就能利用方程思想求得\(\sin\alpha\),\(\cos\alpha\)的值,进而得到\(\tan\alpha\)的值.在求\(\sin\alpha+\cos\alpha\)与\(\sin\alpha-\cos\alpha\)的值时,要注意判断它们的符号.

方法点拨

对于此类结论开放型试题,在解题的过程中需先明确方向,然后顺着这个方向往下走,在此过程中充分运用各种关系进行衍生,显然本题的求解方向为同角三角函数之间的关系.本题中所运用的恒等式如下\(:\)
\((\sin\theta+\cos\theta)^2=1+2\sin\theta\cos\theta;\)
\((\sin\theta-\cos\theta)^2=1-2\sin\theta\cos\theta;\)
\((\sin\theta+\cos\theta)^2+(\sin\theta-\cos\theta)^2=2;\)
\((\sin\theta-\cos\theta)^2=(\sin\theta+\cos\theta)^2-4\sin\theta\cos\theta\).

小结

\(1\).利用\(\sin\theta\pm\cos\theta\)与\(\sin\theta\cos\theta\)之间的关系求值的\(“\)三剑客\(”\)
由\((\sin\alpha+\cos\alpha)^2=1+2\sin\alpha\cos\alpha\),\((\sin\alpha-\cos\alpha)^2=1-2\sin\alpha\cos\alpha\),可知\(:\)如果已知\(\sin\alpha+\cos\alpha\),\(\sin\alpha+\cos\alpha\),\(\sin\alpha-\cos\alpha\),\(\sin\alpha\cos\alpha\)三个式子中任何一个的值,那么就可以利用平方关系求出其余的两个.因此,我们称\(\sin\alpha+\cos\alpha\),\(\sin\alpha\cos\alpha\),\(\sin\alpha-\cos\alpha\)为三角\(“\)三剑客\(”\).
 
\(2\).\(\sin\theta\pm\cos\theta\)的符号的判定方法
(\(1\))\(\sin\theta-\cos\theta\)的符号的判定方法\(:\)
由三角函数的定义知,
当角\(\theta\)的终边落在直线\(y=x\)上时,\(\sin\theta>\cos\theta\),即\(\sin\theta-\cos\theta>0;\)
当角\(\theta\)的终边落在直线\(y=x\)的上半平面区域内时,\(\sin\theta>\cos\theta\),即\(\sin\theta-\cos\theta>0;\)
当角\(\theta\)的终边落在直线\(y=x\)的下半平面区域内时,\(\sin\theta<\cos\theta\),即\(\sin\theta-\cos\theta<0\).
如图\(①\)所示.
(\(2\))\(\sin\theta+\cos\theta\)的符号的判定方法\(:\)
由三角函数的定义知,
当角\(\theta\)的终边落在直线\(y=-x\)上时,\(\sin\theta=-\cos\theta\),即\(\sin\theta+\cos\theta=0;\)
当角\(\theta\)的终边落在直线\(y=-x\)的上半平面区域内时,\(\sin\theta>-\cos\theta\),即\(\sin\theta+\cos\theta>0;\)
当角\(\theta\)的终边落在直线\(y=-x\)的下半平面区域内时,\(\sin\theta<-\cos\theta\),即\(\sin\theta+\cos\theta<0\).如图\(②\)所示.

q.stem: 若\(\dfrac{\pi}2<\alpha<\pi\),则\(sin\alpha-cos\alpha\)的值与\(1\)的大小关系是 ____ .
q.analysis:
若\(\dfrac{\pi}2<\alpha<\pi\),则\(sin\alpha-cos\alpha> 0\),\(sin\alpha cos\alpha<0\),

\(\therefore(sin\alpha-cos\alpha)^2= 1-2sin\alpha cos\alpha>1\),

\(\therefore sin\alpha-cos\alpha>1\).

q.stem: 化简:\(\sqrt{1-2\sin50^\circ \cos50^\circ}\)的结果为 ____ .
q.analysis:
\(\sqrt{1-2\sin50^\circ \cos50^\circ}=\sqrt{\sin^250^\circ+\cos^250^\circ-2\sin50^\circ \cos50^\circ}=\sqrt{(\sin50^\circ-\cos50^\circ)^2}=\)

\(\left| \sin50^\circ-\cos50^\circ\right|=\sin50^\circ-\cos50^\circ\)

故选\(A\)

q.stem:
化简：\((1)\sqrt{1-{\sin}^2440^\circ}=\) ________ ；

\((2)\sqrt{1-2{\sin}40^\circ{\cos}40^\circ}=\) ________ ；

\((3){\sin}\theta{\cos}\theta({\tan}\theta+\dfrac{1}{{\tan}\theta})=\) ________ .

（本题共 3 个空，按顺序填写，中间用「|」隔开）
q.analysis:
\((1)\)原式

\(=\sqrt{1-{\sin}^2(360^\circ+80^\circ)}\)

\(=\sqrt{1-{\sin}^280^\circ}\)

\(=\sqrt{{\cos}^280^\circ}\)

\(={\cos}80^\circ\).

\((2)\)原式

\(=\sqrt{{\sin}^240^\circ+{\cos}^240^\circ-2{\sin}40^\circ{\cos}40^\circ}\)

\(=\sqrt{({\sin}40^\circ-{\cos}40^\circ)^2}\)

\(=\vert{{\sin}40^\circ-{\cos}40^\circ}\vert\)

\(={\cos}40^\circ-{\sin}40^\circ\).

\((3)\)原式\(={\sin}\theta{\cos}\theta(\dfrac{{\sin}\theta}{{\cos}\theta}+\dfrac{{\cos}\theta}{{\sin}\theta})={\sin}^2\theta+{\cos}^2\theta=1\).

q.stem:
化简:
\((1)\)\(cos^6\alpha+sin^6\alpha+3sin^2\alpha cos^2\alpha=\)________;
\((2)\)\(\sqrt{{1+cos\alpha\over1-cos\alpha}}+\sqrt{{1-cos\alpha\over1+cos\alpha}}\) \((180^\circ<\alpha<270^\circ\))\(=\)________
（本题共 2 个空，按顺序填写，中间用「|」隔开）
q.analysis:
\((1)\)原式\(=(cos^2\alpha+sin^2\alpha)(cos^4\alpha-cos^2\alpha sin^2\alpha+sin^4\alpha)+3sin^2\alpha cos^2\alpha\\=cos^4\alpha+2sin^2\alpha cos^2\alpha+sin^4\alpha\\=(sin^2\alpha+cos^2\alpha)^2\\=1.\)

\((2)\)因为\(180^\circ<\alpha<270^\circ\),所以\(sin\alpha<0,\)

方法一  原式\(=\sqrt{{(1+cos\alpha)^2\over1-cos^2\alpha}}+\sqrt{{(1-cos\alpha)^2\over1-cos^2\alpha}}\)

\(={1+cos\alpha\over|sin\alpha|}+{1-cos\alpha\over|sin\alpha|}\)

\(={2\over|sin\alpha|}\)

\(=-{2\over sin\alpha}.\)

方法二  原式\(=\sqrt{(\sqrt{{1+cos\alpha\over1-cos\alpha}}+\sqrt{{1-cos\alpha\over1+cos\alpha}})^2}\)

\(=\sqrt{{1+cos\alpha\over1-cos\alpha}+{1-cos\alpha\over1+cos\alpha}+2}\)

\(=\sqrt{{(1-cos\alpha)^2\over sin^2\alpha}+{(1+cos\alpha)^2\over sin^2\alpha}+2}\)

\(=\sqrt{{2(1+cos^2\alpha)\over sin^2\alpha}+2}\)

\(=\sqrt{{2(1+1-sin^2\alpha)\over sin^2\alpha}+2}\)

\(=\sqrt{2({2\over sin^2\alpha}-1)+2}\)

\(=\sqrt{{4\over sin^2\alpha}}\)

\(={2\over|sin\alpha|}\)

\(=-{2\over sin\alpha}.\)

q.stem: 化简\(:\dfrac{1-\cos^4{\alpha}-\sin^4{\alpha}}{1-\cos^6{\alpha}-\sin^6{\alpha}}=\) ________ .
q.analysis: \(\begin{aligned}  原式&=\dfrac{(1-\cos^4{\alpha})-\sin^4{\alpha}}{(1-\cos^6{\alpha})-\sin^6{\alpha}} \\  &=\dfrac{(1-\cos^2{\alpha})(1+\cos^2{\alpha})-\sin^4{\alpha}}{(1-\cos^2{\alpha})(1+\cos^2{\alpha}+\cos^4{\alpha})-\sin^6{\alpha}} \\  &=\dfrac{\sin^2{\alpha}(1+\cos^2{\alpha})-\sin^4{\alpha}}{\sin^2{\alpha}(1+\cos^2{\alpha}+\cos^4{\alpha})-\sin^6{\alpha}} \\  &=\dfrac{1+\cos^2{\alpha}-\sin^2{\alpha}}{1+\cos^2{\alpha}+\cos^4{\alpha}-\sin^4{\alpha}} \\  &=\dfrac{2\cos^2{\alpha}}{1+\cos^2{\alpha}+(\cos^2{\alpha}+\sin^2{\alpha})(\cos^2{\alpha}-\sin^2{\alpha})}\\  &=\dfrac{2\cos^2{\alpha}}{1+\cos^2{\alpha}+\cos^2{\alpha}-\sin^2{\alpha}} \\  &=\dfrac{2\cos^2{\alpha}}{3\cos^2{\alpha}}\\  &=\dfrac{2}{3}.\end{aligned}\)

\({\cos}^6{\alpha}+{\sin}^6{\alpha}+3{\sin}^2{\alpha}{\cos}^2{\alpha}\)

\(=({\cos}^2{\alpha}+{\sin}^2{\alpha})({\cos}^4{\alpha}-{\cos}^2{\alpha}{\sin}^2{\alpha}+{\sin}^4{\alpha})+3{\sin}^2{\alpha}{\cos}^2{\alpha}\)

\(={\cos}^4{\alpha}+2{\sin}^2{\alpha}{\cos}^2{\alpha}+{\sin}^4{\alpha}\)

\(=({\cos}^2{\alpha}+{\sin}^2{\alpha})^2\)

\(=1\).

q.stem: 若\({\alpha}\)为第三象限角\(,\)则\(\dfrac{\cos{\alpha}}{\sqrt{1-\sin^2{\alpha}}}+\dfrac{2\sin{\alpha}}{\sqrt{1-\cos^2{\alpha}}}\)的值为 ____ .
q.analysis:
\(\because\)\({\alpha}\)为第三象限角,

\(\therefore\)\(\cos{\alpha}<0,\sin{\alpha}<0,\)

\(\therefore\)原式\(=-\dfrac{\cos{\alpha}}{\cos{\alpha}}-\dfrac{2\sin{\alpha}}{\sin{\alpha}}=-3\).

q.stem:
若\({\pi\over2}<\alpha<\pi,\)化简\({cos\alpha\over\sqrt{1-cos^2\alpha}}+{sin\alpha\sqrt{1-sin^2\alpha}\over1-cos^2\alpha
}=\)________.
q.analysis:
因为\({\pi\over2}<\alpha<\pi,\)所以\(cos\alpha<0,sin\alpha>0,\)所以原式\(={cos\alpha\over sin\alpha}-{sin\alpha cos\alpha
\over sin^2\alpha}={cos\alpha\over sin\alpha}-{cos\alpha\over sin\alpha}=0.\)

q.stem: 若\(\beta \in [0,2\pi ),\)且\(\sqrt{1-\cos^2{\beta }}+\sqrt{1-\sin^2{\beta }}=\sin{\beta }-\cos{\beta },\)则\(\beta \)的取值范围是 ____ .
q.analysis:
\(\because\)\(\sqrt{1-\cos^2{\beta }}+\sqrt{1-\sin^2{\beta }}=\left |\sin{\beta } \right |+\left |\cos{\beta } \right |=\sin{\beta } -\cos{\beta },\)

\(\therefore\)\(\sin{\beta } \geq0\)且\(\cos{\beta } \leq 0\).

又\(\because\)\(\beta \in [0,2\pi),\)

\(\therefore\)\(\beta \in [\dfrac{\pi }{2},\pi]\).

故选\(B\).

q.stem:
(\(2024\)·内蒙古联考)
化简\(:\)
\(\cos^6{\alpha}+\sin^6{\alpha}+3\sin^2{\alpha}\cos^2{\alpha}=\) ________ .
q.analysis: 原式\(=(\cos^2{\alpha}+\sin^2{\alpha})( \cos^4{\alpha}-\cos^2{\alpha}\sin^2{\alpha}+\sin^4{\alpha})+3\sin^2{\alpha}\cos^2{\alpha}\)\(=\cos^4{\alpha}+2\sin^2{\alpha}\cos^2{\alpha} +\sin^4{\alpha}=(\sin^2{\alpha}+\cos^2{\alpha} )^2=1\).

m.title: 三角函数式的化简-平方关系 · 讲义
m.body:
知识梳理

\(1\).
基本关系式语言描述
平方关系\(\sin^2\alpha+\cos^2\alpha=1\)同一个角\(\alpha\)的正弦\(、\)余弦的平方和等于\(1\).
基本关系式的变形公式
\[\sin^2\alpha+\cos^2\alpha=1\Rightarrow\begin{cases}\sin^2\alpha=1-\cos^2\alpha,\\\cos^2\alpha=1-\sin^2\alpha, \\\sin\alpha=\pm\sqrt{1-\cos^2\alpha},\\\cos\alpha=\pm\sqrt{1-\sin^2\alpha},\\(\sin\alpha\pm\cos\alpha)^2=1\pm2\sin\alpha\cos\alpha. \end{cases}\]
 
\(2\).化简实际上是一种不指定答案的恒等变形,其一般要求为\(:\)\(①\)项数要最少\(;\)\(②\)次数要最低\(;\)\(③\)函数种类要最少\(;\)\(④\)分母不含根号\(;\)\(⑤\)能求值的要求出值.
化简三角函数式时,应合理利用有关公式,注意化为同角\(、\)同名函数,切化弦等技巧,再利用同角三角函数的基本关系式求解.能开方的尽量开方,能求值的尽量求出值.

方法点拨

化简根式的基本策略是将根号下的式子化为完全平方式. 
要将\(\dfrac{1-\cos\alpha}{1+\cos\alpha}\)化为完全平方式,可将分子\(、\)分母同乘以\(1-\cos\alpha\),其好处在于相乘后分式的分母只有一项且分子为\((1-\cos\alpha)^2\),而\(\cos\alpha\le1\),因此\(\sqrt{\dfrac{1-\cos\alpha}{1+\cos\alpha}}=\dfrac{1-\cos\alpha}{|\sin\alpha|}\),从而使其结果得到了简化.

小结

利用同角三角函数的基本关系式化简的常用方法
 
(\(1\))对于含有根号的,常把被开方数(式)写成完全平方数(式),然后去掉根号以达到化简的目的\(;\)
(\(2\))化切为弦,即把非正\(、\)余弦的函数都化为正\(、\)余弦函数,从而减少三角函数的种类,达到化简的目的\(;\)
(\(3\))对于含有高次的三角函数式,往往借助于因式分解或构造\(\sin^2\alpha+\cos^2\alpha=1\),以降低函数式的次数,达到化简的目的\(;\)
(\(4\))有绝对值的尽量去掉绝对值符号,必要时分情况讨论.

q.stem: 化简:\(sin^2\alpha tan\alpha+{cos^2\alpha\over tan\alpha}+2sin\alpha cos\alpha=\)________
q.analysis:
原式\(=sin^2\alpha\cdot{sin\alpha\over cos\alpha}+cos^2\alpha\cdot{cos\alpha\over sin\alpha}+2sin\alpha cos\alpha\)

\(={sin^4\alpha+cos^4\alpha+2sin^2\alpha cos^2\alpha\over cos\alpha sin\alpha}\)

\(={(sin^2\alpha+cos^2\alpha)^2\over sin\alpha cos\alpha}\)

\(={1\over sin\alpha cos\alpha}.\)

q.stem: 已知\(\dfrac{1+2\sin\theta \cos\theta}{\cos^2\theta-\sin^2\theta}=-3,\)则\(\tan\theta=\) ____ .
q.analysis: 由\(\dfrac{1+2\sin\theta \cos\theta}{\cos^2\theta-\sin^2\theta}=-3,\)可得\(\dfrac{\sin^2\theta+\cos^2\theta+2\sin\theta \cos\theta}{\cos^2\theta-\sin^2\theta}=\dfrac{\tan^2\theta+1+2\tan\theta}{1-\tan^2\theta}=-3,\)解得\(\tan\theta=2\).故选\(D\).

q.stem: 已知\(tan\alpha=3\),则\(\dfrac23sin^2\alpha+\dfrac14cos^2\alpha\)的值为 ________ .
q.analysis:
\(\because tan\alpha=3\),

\(\therefore\dfrac23sin^2\alpha+\dfrac14cos^2\alpha=\dfrac{\dfrac23sin^2\alpha+\dfrac14cos^2\alpha}{sin^2\alpha+cos^2\alpha}\)
\(=\dfrac{\dfrac23tan^2\alpha+\dfrac14}{tan^2\alpha+1}=\dfrac{\dfrac23\times3^2 +\dfrac14}{3^2+1}=\dfrac58\).

q.stem:
(\(2024\)·上海联考)
如果角\({\theta}\)满足\(\sin\theta+\cos\theta=\sqrt{2},\)那么\(\tan\theta+\dfrac{1}{\tan\theta}\)的值是 ____ .
q.analysis:
\(\because\)\(\sin\theta+\cos\theta=\sqrt{2},\)

\(\therefore\)\(1+2\sin\theta\cos\theta=2,\)即\( \sin\theta\cos\theta=\dfrac{1}{2},\)那么\(\tan\theta+\dfrac{1}{\tan\theta}=\)\(\dfrac{\sin\theta}{\cos\theta}+\dfrac{\cos\theta}{\sin\theta}=\dfrac{1}{\sin\theta\cos\theta}=2,\)故选\(D\).

q.stem: 已知角\({\alpha}\)的终边经过点\((6,8),\)则\(\dfrac{\sin{\alpha}+\cos{\alpha}}{\sin{\alpha}-\cos{\alpha}}=\) ____ .
q.analysis: 由三角函数的定义可知\(\tan{\alpha}=\dfrac{4}{3},\)所以\(\dfrac{\sin{\alpha}+\cos{\alpha}}{\sin{\alpha}-\cos{\alpha}}=\dfrac{\tan{\alpha}+1}{\tan{\alpha}-1}=7\).

q.stem: 若角\(\alpha\)的终边落在直线\(y=2x\)上,则\(sin^2\alpha-cos^2\alpha+sin\alpha cos\alpha\)的值为 ____ .
q.analysis:
\(\because\)角\(\alpha\)的终边落在直线\(y=2x\)上,
\(\therefore tan\alpha= 2\),

\(\therefore sin^2\alpha-cos^2\alpha+ sin\alpha cos\alpha=\dfrac{sin^2\alpha-cos^2\alpha+sin\alpha cos\alpha}{sin^2\alpha+cos^2\alpha}=\dfrac{tan^2\alpha- 1+tan\alpha}{tan^2\alpha+ 1}=\dfrac{4-1+2}{4+1}=1\).

q.stem:
(\(2024\)·广东深圳四区联考)
已知\(\dfrac{1+2\sin\theta \cos\theta}{\cos^2\theta-\sin^2\theta}=-3,\)则\(\tan\theta=\) ____ .
q.analysis: 由\(\dfrac{1+2\sin\theta \cos\theta}{\cos^2\theta-\sin^2\theta}=-3,\)可得\(\dfrac{\sin^2\theta+\cos^2\theta+2\sin\theta \cos\theta}{\cos^2\theta-\sin^2\theta}=\dfrac{\tan^2\theta+1+2\tan\theta}{1-\tan^2\theta}=-3,\)解得\(\tan\theta=2\).故选\(D\).

q.stem:
(\(2024\)·山西联考)
已知\(2\sin\theta+\sqrt{3}\tan\theta=0,\)则角\({\theta}\)的值不可能是 ____ .
q.analysis:
\(\because\)\(2\sin\theta+\sqrt{3}\tan\theta=2\sin\theta+\sqrt{3}\dfrac{\sin\theta}{\cos\theta}=\sin\theta(2+\dfrac{\sqrt{3}}{\cos\theta})=0,\)

\(\therefore\)\(\sin\theta=0\)或\(\cos\theta=-\dfrac{\sqrt{3}}{2},\)

\(\therefore\)\({\theta}=-210^\circ ,-180^\circ ,210^\circ \)都满足题意\(,\)而\({\theta}=-240^\circ \)不满足.故选\(D\).

q.stem: 已知\(\tan{\alpha}=2,\)则\(\dfrac{\sin{\alpha}+2\cos{\alpha}}{\sin{\alpha}-\cos{\alpha}}=\) ________ \(,\)\(\dfrac{1}{\sin^2{\alpha}+\sin{\alpha}\cos{\alpha}-2\cos^2{\alpha}}=\) ________ .
q.analysis:
\(\because\)\(\tan{\alpha}=2,\)

\(\therefore\)\(\dfrac{\sin{\alpha}+2\cos{\alpha}}{\sin{\alpha}-\cos{\alpha}}=\)\(\dfrac{\tan{\alpha}+2}{\tan{\alpha}-1}=\dfrac{2+2}{2-1}=\)\(4,\)

\(\dfrac{1}{\sin^2{\alpha}+\sin{\alpha}\cos{\alpha}-2\cos^2{\alpha}}\)\(=\dfrac{\sin^2{\alpha}+\cos^2{\alpha}}{\sin^2{\alpha}+\sin{\alpha}\cos{\alpha}-2\cos^2{\alpha}}=\)\(\dfrac{\tan^2{\alpha}+1}{\tan^2{\alpha}+\tan{\alpha}-2}=\)\(\dfrac{4+1}{4+2-2}=\dfrac{5}{4}\).

q.stem: 已知\({\alpha}\)为第二象限角\(,\)则\(\cos{\alpha}\sqrt{\dfrac{1+\sin{\alpha}}{1-\sin{\alpha}}}+\sin^2{\alpha}\cdot\sqrt{1+\dfrac{1}{\tan^2{\alpha}}}=\) ________ .
q.analysis:
因为\({\alpha}\)为第二象限角\(,\)所以\(\sin{\alpha}>0,\cos{\alpha}<0\).

所以\(\cos{\alpha}\sqrt{\dfrac{1+\sin{\alpha}}{1-\sin{\alpha}}}=\cos{\alpha}\sqrt{\dfrac{(1+\sin{\alpha})^2}{\cos^2{\alpha}}}=\cos{\alpha}\cdot\dfrac{1+\sin{\alpha}}{\left | \cos{\alpha}\right |}=-1-\sin{\alpha},\)

\(\sin^2{\alpha}\sqrt{1+\dfrac{1}{\tan^2{\alpha}}}=\sin^2{\alpha}\times\dfrac{1}{\sin{\alpha}}=\sin{\alpha},\)

所以\(\cos{\alpha}\sqrt{\dfrac{1+\sin{\alpha}}{1-\sin{\alpha}}}+\sin^2{\alpha}\sqrt{1+\dfrac{1}{\tan^2{\alpha}}}=-1\).

m.title: 三角函数式的化简-商数关系 · 讲义
m.body:
知识梳理

\(1\).同角三角函数的基本关系
基本关系式语言描述
平方关系\(\sin^2\alpha+\cos^2\alpha=1\)同一个角\(\alpha\)的正弦\(、\)余弦的平方和等于\(1\)
商数关系\(\dfrac{\sin\alpha}{\cos\alpha}=\tan\alpha(\cos\alpha\ne0)\)同一个角\(\alpha\)的正弦\(、\)余弦的商等于角\(\alpha\)的正切
 
\(2\).基本关系式的变形公式
\[\sin^2\alpha+\cos^2\alpha=1\Rightarrow\begin{cases}\sin^2\alpha=1-\cos^2\alpha,\\\cos^2\alpha=1-\sin^2\alpha,\\\sin\alpha=\pm\sqrt{1-\cos^2\alpha},\\cos\alpha=\pm\sqrt{1-\sin^2\alpha}, \\(\sin\alpha\pm\cos\alpha)^2=1\pm2\sin\alpha\cos\alpha. \end{cases}\]
\[\tan\alpha=\dfrac{\sin\alpha}{\cos\alpha}\Rightarrow\begin{cases}\sin\alpha=\tan\alpha\cos\alpha, \\\cos\alpha=\dfrac{\sin\alpha}{\tan\alpha}. \end{cases}\]
 
\(3\).化简实际上是一种不指定答案的恒等变形,其一般要求为\(:\)\(①\)项数要最少\(;\)\(②\)次数要最低\(;\)\(③\)函数种类要最少\(;\)\(④\)分母不含根号\(;\)\(⑤\)能求值的要求出值.
化简三角函数式时,应合理利用有关公式,注意化为同角\(、\)同名函数,切化弦等技巧,再利用同角三角函数的基本关系式求解.能开方的尽量开方,能求值的尽量求出值.

小结

三角函数式的化简思路
\(1\).化简原则：
三角函数式的化简就是代数式的恒等变形,使结果尽可能简单,也就是项数尽可能少,次数尽可能低,函数种类尽可能少,式子中尽量不含根号,能求值的一定要求值.
 
\(2\).化简常用的方法\(:\)
(\(1\))对于含有根号的,常把被开方数(式)化成完全平方数(式),然后去根号达到化简的目的\(;\)
(\(2\))化切为弦,从而减少函数种类,达到化简的目的\(;\)
(\(3\))对于含高次的三角函数式,往往借助于因式分解或构造\(\sin^2\alpha+\cos^2\alpha=1\),以降低次数,达到化简的目的.

q.stem:
已知\({\sin}\theta\)、\({\cos}\theta\)是关于\(x\)的方程\(x^2-ax+a=0(a{\in}\boldsymbol{\mathrm{R}})\)的两个根.

\((1){\sin}^3\theta+{\cos}^3\theta\)的值为 ________ ；

\((2){\tan}\theta+\dfrac{1}{{\tan}\theta}\)的值为 ________ .

（本题共 2 个空，按顺序填写，中间用「|」隔开）
q.analysis:
由根与系数的关系，知\({\sin}\theta+{\cos}\theta=a\)，\({\sin}\theta\cdot{\cos}\theta=a\).

\({\because}({\sin}\theta+{\cos}\theta)^2=1+2{\sin}\theta{\cos}\theta\)，

\({\therefore}a^2=1+2a\).

解得\(a=1-\sqrt{2}\)或\(a=1+\sqrt{2}\).

易知\(\vert{{\sin}\theta}\vert{\le}1\)，\(\vert{{\cos}\theta}\vert{\le}1\)，

\({\therefore}\vert{{\sin}\theta{\cos}\theta}\vert{\le}1\)，即\(\vert{a}\vert{\le}1\)，

\({\therefore}a=1-\sqrt{2}\).

\((1){\sin}^3\theta+{\cos}^3\theta\)

\(=({\sin}\theta+{\cos}\theta)\cdot({\sin}^2\theta-{\sin}\theta{\cos}\theta+{\cos}^2\theta)\)

\(=({\sin}\theta+{\cos}\theta)\cdot(1-{\sin}\theta{\cos}\theta)\)

\(=a(1-a)\)

\(=\sqrt{2}-2\).

\((2){\tan}\theta+\dfrac{1}{{\tan}\theta}\)\(=\dfrac{{\sin}\theta}{{\cos}\theta}+\dfrac{{\cos}\theta}{{\sin}\theta}\)\(=\dfrac{{\sin}^2\theta+{\cos}^2\theta}{{\sin}\theta{\cos}\theta}\)\(=\dfrac{1}{{\sin}\theta{\cos}\theta}\)\(=\dfrac{1}{a}\)\(=\dfrac{1}{1-\sqrt{2}}\)\(=-1-\sqrt{2}\).

q.stem:
已知关于\(x\)的方程\(2x^2-(\sqrt{3}+1)x+m=0\)的两根为\({\sin}\theta\)和\({\cos}\theta\)，且\(\theta{\in}(0\)，\(2{\pi})\).

\((1)\)\(\dfrac{{\sin}^2\theta}{{\sin}\theta-{\cos}\theta}+\dfrac{{\cos}\theta}{1-{\tan}\theta}\)的值为 ________ ；

\((2)m\)的值为 ________ ；

\((3)\)方程的两根\(x_1=\) ________ （较小的根），\(x_2=\) ________ （较大的根），及此时\(\theta\)的值为 ________ .

（本题共 5 个空，按顺序填写，中间用「|」隔开）
q.analysis:
由一元二次方程根与系数的关系可知\(\begin{cases}{\sin}\theta+{\cos}\theta=\dfrac{\sqrt{3}+1}{2},①\\{\sin}\theta\cdot{\cos}\theta=\dfrac{m}{2}.②\end{cases}\)

\((1)\dfrac{{\sin}^2\theta}{{\sin}\theta-{\cos}\theta}+\dfrac{{\cos}\theta}{1-{\tan}\theta}\)

\(=\dfrac{{\sin}^2\theta}{{\sin}\theta-{\cos}\theta}+\dfrac{{\cos}^2\theta}{{\cos}\theta-{\sin}\theta}\)

\(={\sin}\theta+{\cos}\theta\)

\(=\dfrac{\sqrt{3}+1}{2}\).

\((2)①\)两边平方得\(1+2{\sin}\theta{\cos}\theta=\dfrac{\sqrt{3}+2}{2}\)，

将\(②\)代入得\(m=\dfrac{\sqrt{3}}{2}\).

\((3)\)由\((2)\)知，原方程为\(2x^2-(1+\sqrt{3})x+\dfrac{\sqrt{3}}{2}=0\)，

解得\(x_1=\dfrac{\sqrt{3}}{2}\)，\(x_2=\dfrac{1}{2}\)，

\({\therefore}\begin{cases}{\sin}\theta=\dfrac{\sqrt{3}}{2},\\{\cos}\theta=\dfrac{1}{2}\end{cases}\)或\(\begin{cases}{\sin}\theta=\dfrac{1}{2},\\{\cos}\theta=\dfrac{\sqrt{3}}{2},\end{cases}\)

\({\because}\theta{\in}(0\)，\(2{\pi})\)，

\({\therefore}\theta=\dfrac{{\pi}}{6}\)或\(\dfrac{{\pi}}{3}\).

q.stem:
\((湖北黄石二中期末考试)\)已知\(\theta\in(0,\pi),\)且\(sin\theta,cos\theta\)是方程\(25x^2-5x-12=0\)的两个根,求
\(sin^3\theta+cos^3\theta=\)_________,\(tan\theta-cot\theta=\)________.

（本题共 2 个空，按顺序填写，中间用「|」隔开）
q.analysis:
方法一  由题意,得\(sin\theta+cos\theta={1\over5},sin\theta cos\theta=-{12\over25},\therefore sin^3\theta+cos^3\theta
=(sin\theta+cos\theta)(sin^2\theta-sin\theta cos\theta+cos^2\theta)=(sin\theta+cos\theta)(1-sin\theta cos\theta)={1\over5}\times(1+{12\over25})=
{37\over125}.\)
\(tan\theta-cot\theta={sin\theta\over cos\theta}-{cos\theta\over sin\theta}={sin^2\theta-cos^2\theta\over sin\theta cos\theta
}={(sin\theta+cos\theta)(sin\theta-cos\theta)\over sin\theta cos\theta}.\because \theta\in(0,\pi),sin\theta cos\theta<0,
\therefore sin\theta>0,cos\theta<0,\)则\(sin\theta-cos\theta>0.\therefore sin\theta-cos\theta=
\sqrt{(sin\theta-cos\theta)^2}=\sqrt{1-2sin\theta cos\theta}=\sqrt{1+2\times{12\over25}}=\sqrt{{49\over25}}={7\over5},
\therefore tan\theta-cot\theta={{1\over5}\times{7\over5}\over-{12\over25}}=-{7\over12}.\)
方法二  方程\(25x^2-5x-12=0\)的两根分别为\({4\over5}\)和\(-{3\over5}.\)
\(\because \theta\in(0,\pi),\)且\(sin\theta cos\theta=-{12\over25}<0.
\therefore sin\theta>0,cos\theta<0,\)则\(sin\theta={4\over5},cos\theta=-{3\over5},\)
\(\therefore sin^3\theta+cos^3\theta=({4\over5})^3+(-{3\over5})^3={64\over125}-{27\over125}={37\over125}.
tan\theta-cot\theta={sin\theta\over cos\theta}-{cos\theta\over sin\theta}={{4\over5}\over-{3\over5}}-{-{3\over5}\over{4\over5}}=
-{7\over12}.\)

q.stem:
(\(2024\)·宁夏统考)
已知在\(\triangle ABC\)中,\(\sin A+\cos A=\dfrac{1}{5}\).
(\(1\))\(\sin A\cos A\)的值为 ________ \(;\)
(\(2\))\(\triangle ABC\)是 ________ (填\(①\)表示\(“\)锐角三角形\(”\),\(②\)表示\(“\)钝角三角形\(”\))
(\(3\))\(\tan A\)的值为 ________ .
q.analysis:
(\(1\))\(\because\)\(\sin A+\cos A=\dfrac{1}{5}\),\(①\)

两边平方,得\(1+2\sin A\cos A=\dfrac{1}{25}\),

\(\therefore\)\(\sin A\cos A=-\dfrac{12}{25}\).

(\(2\))由\(\sin A\cos A=-\dfrac{12}{25}<0\),且\(0<A<\pi\),可知\(\cos A<0\),

\(\therefore\)\(A\)为钝角,

\(\therefore\)\(\triangle ABC\)是钝角三角形.

(\(3\))\(\because\)\((\sin A-\cos A)^2\)

\(=1-2\sin A\cos A\)

\(=1+\dfrac{24}{25}\)

\(=\dfrac{49}{25}\),

又\(\because\)\(\sin A>0\),\(\cos A<0\),

\(\therefore\)\(\sin A-\cos A>0\),

\(\therefore\)\(\sin A-\cos A=\dfrac{7}{5}\).\(②\)

由\(①②\)可得\(\sin A=\dfrac{4}{5}\),\(\cos A=-\dfrac{3}{5}\),

\(\therefore\)\(\tan A=\dfrac{\sin A}{\cos A}=\dfrac{\dfrac{4}{5}}{-\dfrac{3}{5}}=-\dfrac{4}{3}\).

q.stem: 已知\(sin\alpha\),\(cos\alpha\)是关于\(x\)的方程\(x^2-ax+a=0\)(\(a\in\)R)的两个根,则\(sin^3\alpha+cos^3\alpha=\) ____ .
q.analysis:
由题意可知,\(sin \alpha+cos\alpha= a\),\(sin\alpha cos\alpha =a\),

\(\therefore sin^2\alpha+cos^2\alpha=(sin\alpha+cos \alpha)^2-2sin \alpha cos \alpha=a^2-2a=1\),

解得\(a=1-\sqrt2\)或\(a=1+\sqrt2\),
\(\because sin\alpha\),\(cos\alpha\)是关于\(x\)的方程\(x^2 -ax+a=0\)的两个根,

\(\therefore\Delta=a^2-4a≥0\),

解得\(a≥4\)或\(a≤0\),
\(a=1-\sqrt2\),
故\(sin^3\alpha+cos^3\alpha=( sin \alpha+cos \alpha) ( sin^2\alpha-sin\alpha cos\alpha+ cos^2\alpha)\)\(= ( sin \alpha+cos\alpha) ( 1-sin\alpha cos\alpha)=a(1-a)=-2+\sqrt2\).

q.stem:
\((湖北黄石二中期末考试)\)已知\(\theta\in(0,\pi),\)且\(sin\theta,cos\theta\)是方程\(25x^2-5x-12=0\)的两个根,求
\(sin^3\theta+cos^3\theta=\)_________,\(tan\theta-cot\theta=\)________.
q.analysis:
方法一  由题意,得\(sin\theta+cos\theta={1\over5},sin\theta cos\theta=-{12\over25},\therefore sin^3\theta+cos^3\theta
=(sin\theta+cos\theta)(sin^2\theta-sin\theta cos\theta+cos^2\theta)=(sin\theta+cos\theta)(1-sin\theta cos\theta)={1\over5}\times(1+{12\over25})=
{37\over125}.\)
\(tan\theta-cot\theta={sin\theta\over cos\theta}-{cos\theta\over sin\theta}={sin^2\theta-cos^2\theta\over sin\theta cos\theta
}={(sin\theta+cos\theta)(sin\theta-cos\theta)\over sin\theta cos\theta}.\because \theta\in(0,\pi),sin\theta cos\theta<0,
\therefore sin\theta>0,cos\theta<0,\)则\(sin\theta-cos\theta>0.\therefore sin\theta-cos\theta=
\sqrt{(sin\theta-cos\theta)^2}=\sqrt{1-2sin\theta cos\theta}=\sqrt{1+2\times{12\over25}}=\sqrt{{49\over25}}={7\over5},
\therefore tan\theta-cot\theta={{1\over5}\times{7\over5}\over-{12\over25}}=-{7\over12}.\)
方法二  方程\(25x^2-5x-12=0\)的两根分别为\({4\over5}\)和\(-{3\over5}.\)
\(\because \theta\in(0,\pi),\)且\(sin\theta cos\theta=-{12\over25}<0.
\therefore sin\theta>0,cos\theta<0,\)则\(sin\theta={4\over5},cos\theta=-{3\over5},\)
\(\therefore sin^3\theta+cos^3\theta=({4\over5})^3+(-{3\over5})^3={64\over125}-{27\over125}={37\over125}.
tan\theta-cot\theta={sin\theta\over cos\theta}-{cos\theta\over sin\theta}={{4\over5}\over-{3\over5}}-{-{3\over5}\over{4\over5}}=
-{7\over12}.\)

q.stem:
(\(2024\)·江苏苏州联考)
若\({\theta}\)是\(\triangle ABC\)的一个内角\(,\)且\(\sin\theta\cos\theta=-\dfrac{1}{8},\)则\(\sin\theta-\cos\theta\)的值为 ____ .
q.analysis:
\(\because\)\({\theta}\)是\(\triangle ABC\)的一个内角\(,\)且 \(\sin\theta\cos\theta=-\dfrac{1}{8},\)

\(\therefore\)\(\sin\theta>0, \cos\theta<0, \)

\(\therefore\)\(\sin\theta-\cos\theta>0,\)

\(\because\)\((\sin\theta-\cos\theta)^2=1-2\sin\theta\cos\theta=1+\dfrac{1}{4}=\dfrac{5}{4},\)

\(\therefore\)\(\sin\theta-\cos\theta=\dfrac{\sqrt{5}}{2}\).故选\(A\).

q.stem: 若\(\sin{A}=\dfrac{4}{5}\)且\(A\)是三角形中的一个内角\(,\)则\(\dfrac{5\sin{A}+8}{15\cos{A}-7}=\) ________ .\((\)答案不要用小数表示\()\)
q.analysis:
\(\because\)\(\sin{A}=\dfrac{4}{5}>0,\)

\(\therefore\)\(A\)为锐角或钝角.

当\(A\)为锐角时\(,\cos{A}=\sqrt{1-\sin^2{A}}=\dfrac{3}{5},\)

\(\therefore\)\(\dfrac{5\sin{A}+8}{15\cos{A}-7}=\dfrac{5\times\dfrac{4}{5}+8}{15\times\dfrac{3}{5}-7}=6;\)

当\(A\)为钝角时\(,\cos{A}=-\sqrt{1-\sin^2{A}}=-\dfrac{3}{5},\)

\(\therefore\)\(\dfrac{5\sin{A}+8}{15\cos{A}-7}=\dfrac{5\times\dfrac{4}{5}+8}{15\times(-\dfrac{3}{5})-7}=-\dfrac{3}{4}\).

综上\(,\dfrac{5\sin{A}+8}{15\cos{A}-7}\)的值为\(6\)或\(-\dfrac{3}{4}\).

q.stem: 已知\(tan\alpha\),\(\dfrac1{tan\alpha}\)是关于\(x\)的方程\(x^2-kx+k^2-3= 0\)的两个实数根,且\(3\pi<\alpha<\dfrac72\pi\),则\(cos\alpha+sin\alpha\)的值为 ________ .
q.analysis:
\(\because tan\alpha\),\(\dfrac1{tan\alpha}\)是关于\(x\)的方程\(x^2-kx+k^2-3= 0\)的两个实数根,

\(\therefore tan\alpha·\dfrac1{tan\alpha}=k^2-3=1\),

\(\therefore k=\pm2\).
\(\because 3\pi<\alpha<\dfrac72\pi\),

\(\therefore tan\alpha>0\),

则\(tan \alpha+\dfrac1{tan\alpha}=k=2\).
此时,方程为\(x^2-2x+1=0\),

解得\(tan\alpha=1\),

\(\therefore\alpha=\dfrac{13}4\pi\),

则\(sin\alpha=cos\alpha=-\dfrac{\sqrt2}2\),
\(\therefore cos \alpha+sin \alpha=-\sqrt2\).

q.stem:
已知关于\(x\)的方程\(5x^2+x+m=0\)的两根为\({\sin}\theta\)，\({\cos}\theta\)，\(\theta{\in}(0\)，\(\dfrac{{\pi}}{4})\).(请填写分数形式)

\((1)\)\({\sin}(\theta+\dfrac{{\pi}}{2}){\cos}(\theta-\dfrac{{\pi}}{2})=\) ________ ；

\((2)\dfrac{{\sin}\theta}{1-\dfrac{1}{{\tan}\theta}}+\dfrac{{\cos}\theta}{1-{\tan}\theta}\)的值为 ________ ；

\((3)\dfrac{{\tan}\theta+1}{{\tan}\theta-1}\)的值为 ________ .
q.analysis:
关于\(x\)的方程\(5x^2+x+m=0\)的两根为\({\sin}\theta\)，\({\cos}\theta\)，

由根与系数的关系得，\({\sin}\theta+{\cos}\theta=-\dfrac{1}{5}\).

\((1){\because}\)\({\sin}\theta+{\cos}\theta=-\dfrac{1}{5}\)，

\({\therefore}({\sin}\theta+{\cos}\theta)^2=\dfrac{1}{25}\)，

即\(1+2{\sin}\theta{\cos}\theta=\dfrac{1}{25}\)，

\({\therefore}{\sin}(\theta+\dfrac{{\pi}}{2}){\cos}(\theta-\dfrac{{\pi}}{2})={\sin}{\alpha}{\cos}{\alpha}=-\dfrac{12}{25}\).

\((2)\dfrac{{\sin}\theta}{1-\dfrac{1}{{\tan}\theta}}+\dfrac{{\cos}\theta}{1-{\tan}\theta}\)

\(=\dfrac{{\sin}^2\theta}{{\sin}\theta-{\cos}\theta}+\dfrac{{\cos}^2\theta}{{\cos}\theta-{\sin}\theta}\)

\(={\sin}\theta+{\cos}\theta=-\dfrac{1}{5}\).

\((3)\)由\((1)\)知\(2{\sin}\theta{\cos}\theta=-\dfrac{24}{25}\)，

所以\(({\sin}\theta-{\cos}\theta)^2=1-2{\sin}\theta{\cos}\theta=\dfrac{49}{25}\)，

又\(\theta{\in}(0\)，\(\dfrac{{\pi}}{4})\)，

所以\({\sin}\theta-{\cos}\theta<0\)，

\({\therefore}{\sin}\theta-{\cos}\theta=-\dfrac{7}{5}\)，

所以\(\dfrac{{\tan}\theta+1}{{\tan}\theta-1}=\dfrac{{\sin}\theta+{\cos}\theta}{{\sin}\theta-{\cos}\theta}=\dfrac{1}{7}\).

m.title: 同角三角函数的基本关系式的综合应用 · 讲义
m.body:
知识梳理

\(1\).同角三角函数的基本关系
基本关系式语言描述
平方关系\(\sin^2\alpha+\cos^2\alpha=1\)同一个角\(\alpha\)的正弦\(、\)余弦的平方和等于\(1\)
商数关系\(\dfrac{\sin\alpha}{\cos\alpha}=\tan\alpha(\cos\alpha\ne0)\)同一个角\(\alpha\)的正弦\(、\)余弦的商等于角\(\alpha\)的正切
 
\(2\).基本关系式的变形公式
\[\sin^2\alpha+\cos^2\alpha=1\Rightarrow\begin{cases}\sin^2\alpha=1-\cos^2\alpha,\\\cos^2\alpha=1-\sin^2\alpha,\\\sin\alpha=\pm\sqrt{1-\cos^2\alpha},\\cos\alpha=\pm\sqrt{1-\sin^2\alpha}, \\(\sin\alpha\pm\cos\alpha)^2=1\pm2\sin\alpha\cos\alpha. \end{cases}\]
\[\tan\alpha=\dfrac{\sin\alpha}{\cos\alpha}\Rightarrow\begin{cases}\sin\alpha=\tan\alpha\cos\alpha, \\\cos\alpha=\dfrac{\sin\alpha}{\tan\alpha}. \end{cases}\]
\(3\).三角函数经常与二次函数\(、\)一元二次方程等知识结合起来考查.此类问题常常利用换元法,结合一元二次方程根与系数的关系与同角三角函数的基本关系求解.

方法点拨

在同角三角函数的基本关系中,\(\sin^2\alpha+\cos^2\alpha=1\)可变换成\((\sin\alpha+\cos\alpha)^2-2\sin\alpha\cos\alpha=1\),其中\(\sin\alpha+\cos\alpha\)与\(\sin\alpha\cdot\cos\alpha\)很容易与一元二次方程的根与系数的关系产生联系.若以\(\sin\alpha\),\(\cos\alpha\)为两根构造一元二次方程,则可利用上述关系解决相关问题.

小结

解决同角三角函数的基本关系与一元二次方程的综合问题时,主要从以下几个方面考虑
 
(\(1\))利用平方关系把已知条件转化为关于三角函数的一元二次方程\(;\)
(\(2\))利用一元二次方程根与系数的关系寻求等量关系\(;\)
(\(3\))利用一元二次方程根的判别式判断根的存在情况及确定参数的取值范围\(;\)
(\(4\))充分利用同角三角函数的基本关系式进行化简.

q.analysis:
对于选项\(A,\)令\(\alpha =\frac{\pi}{2},\)得\(\sin (\pi-\alpha)=\sin \frac{\pi}{2}=1\ne-\sin \frac{\pi}{2},\)所以\(A\)错误\(;\)

对于选项\(B,\)令\(\alpha=0,\)得\(\cos (\pi+\alpha)=\cos \pi =-1\ne \cos 0,\)所以\(B\)错误\(;\)

q.stem:
求下列三角函数的值.

\((1){\tan}(-135^\circ)=\) ________ ；

\((2){\cos}\dfrac{4{\pi}}{3}=\) ________ ；

\((3){\cos}(-150^\circ)=\) ________ ；

\((4){\sin}\dfrac{7{\pi}}{4}=\) ________ .

（本题共 4 个空，按顺序填写，中间用「|」隔开）

(\(2024\)·上海联考)
已知 \(cos\left(α-\pi\right)=-\dfrac{5}{13}\)，且 \(α\) 是第四象限角，则 \(sin\left(-2\pi+α\right)\) 等于 ____ .
q.analysis:
由 \(cos\left(α-\pi\right)=-\dfrac{5}{13}\)，得 \(cos\,α=\dfrac{5}{13}\).

因为 \(α\) 为第四象限角，

所以 \(sin\left(-2\pi+α\right)=sin\,α=-\sqrt{1-cos^2α}=-\dfrac{12}{13}\).

q.stem: 已知函数\(f(x)={\cos}\dfrac{x}{2}\)，则下列等式成立的是 ____ .

已知函数\(f(x)= cos\dfrac x2\),给出下列\(4\)个等式:
\(①f(2\pi-x)=f(x)\);\(②f(2\pi+x)=f(x)\);\(③f(-x)=f(x)\);\(④f(4\pi+x)=f(x)\).其中成立的是 ________ (填序号,序号从小到大排列).
q.analysis:
\(f(2\pi-x )= cos\dfrac{2\pi-x}2=cos\left(\pi-\dfrac x2\right)=-cos\dfrac x2 =-f(x)\),\(①\)不成立;

\(f(2\pi +x) = cos\dfrac{2\pi+x}2=cos\left(\pi+\dfrac x2\right)=-cos\dfrac x2=-f(x)\),\(②\)不成立;
\(f(-x)=cos\dfrac{-x}2=cos\dfrac x2=f(x)\),\(③\)成立;
\(f(4\pi+x)= cos\dfrac{4\pi+x}2 =cos\left( 2\pi+\dfrac x2\right)= cos \dfrac x2=f(x)\),\(④\)成立.

故成立的是\(③④\).

q.stem: 已知\(\alpha\)为锐角,\(2tan(\pi-\alpha)-3cos\left(\dfrac{\pi}2 +\beta\right)+5=0\),\(tan( \pi+\alpha) +6sin( \pi+\beta)-1=0\),则\(sin\alpha\)的值是 ____ .
q.analysis:
由已知可得\(- 2tan\alpha+3sin \beta+5= 0①\),\(tan\alpha- 6sin \beta-1= 0②\).

由\(①②\)解得\(tan\alpha=3\),

又\(tan\alpha=\dfrac{sin\alpha}{cos\alpha}\),

\(\therefore9=\dfrac{sin^2\alpha}{cos^2\alpha}=\dfrac{sin^2\alpha}{1-sin^2\alpha}\),
\(\therefore sin^2\alpha=\dfrac9{10}\),

\(\because\alpha\)为锐角,

\(\therefore sin\alpha=\dfrac{3\sqrt10}{10}\),故选\(C\).

q.stem: \(sin\left(2n\pi+\dfrac{2\pi}{3}\right)·cos\left(n\pi+\dfrac{4\pi}{3}\right)\left(n\in\mathbf{Z}\right)\) 的值为 ________ .
q.analysis:
方法一：\(①\) 当 \(n\) 为奇数时，原式 \(=sin\,\dfrac{2\pi}{3}·\left(-cos\,\dfrac{4\pi}{3}\right)=sin\left(\pi-\dfrac{\pi}{3}\right)·\left[-cos\left(\pi+\dfrac{\pi}{3}\right)\right]=sin\,\dfrac{\pi}{3}·cos\,\dfrac{\pi}{3}=\dfrac{\sqrt{3}}{2}\times\dfrac{1}{2}=\dfrac{\sqrt{3}}{4}\).

\(②\) 当 \(n\) 为偶数时，原式 \(=sin\,\dfrac{2\pi}{3}·cos\,\dfrac{4\pi}{3}=sin\left(\pi-\dfrac{\pi}{3}\right)·cos\left(\pi+\dfrac{\pi}{3}\right)=sin\,\dfrac{\pi}{3}·\left(-cos\,\dfrac{\pi}{3}\right)=\dfrac{\sqrt{3}}{2}\times\left(-\dfrac{1}{2}\right)=-\dfrac{\sqrt{3}}{4}\).

综上可知，原式 \(=\left(-1\right)^{n+1}\dfrac{\sqrt{3}}{4}\).

方法二：原式 \(=sin\,\dfrac{2\pi}{3}·\left(-1\right)^ncos\,\dfrac{4\pi}{3}=sin\left(\pi-\dfrac{\pi}{3}\right)·\left(-1\right)^ncos\left(\pi+\dfrac{\pi}{3}\right)=sin\,\dfrac{\pi}{3}·\left(-1\right)^n·\left(-cos\,\dfrac{\pi}{3}\right)=\left(-1\right)^n\times\dfrac{\sqrt{3}}{2}\times\left(-\dfrac{1}{2}\right)=\left(-1\right)^{n+1}\dfrac{\sqrt{3}}{4}\).

m.title: 诱导公式二、三、四 · 讲义
m.body:
知识梳理

同名三角函数之间的诱导公式
\(1\).知识回顾\(:\)公式一
\[\sin(\alpha+k\cdot2\pi)=\sin\alpha,k\in\mathbf{Z}\]
\[\cos(\alpha+k\cdot2\pi)=\cos\alpha,k\in\mathbf{Z}\]
\[\tan(\alpha+k\cdot2\pi)=\tan\alpha,k\in\mathbf{Z}\]
 
\(2\).公式二\(\sim\)四
如图\(1\),在直角坐标系内,设任意角\(\alpha\)的终边与单位圆交于点\(P_1\),作\(P_1\)关于原点的对称点\(P_2\),则以\(OP_2\)为终边的角为\(\pi+\alpha\).
设\(P_1(x_1,y_1)\),\(P_2(x_2,y_2)\).因为\(P_2\)是点\(P_1\)关于原点的对称点,所以\(x_2=-x_1\),\(y_2=-y_1\).
根据三角函数的定义,得\(\sin\alpha=y_1\),\(\cos\alpha=x\),\(\tan\alpha=\dfrac{y_1}{x_1};\)
\(\sin(\pi+\alpha)=y_2\),\(\cos(\pi+\alpha)=x_2\),\(\tan(\pi+\alpha)=\dfrac{y_2}{x_2}\).
从而得公式二\(:\)
\[\sin(\pi+\alpha)=-\sin\alpha\]
\[\cos(\pi+\alpha)=-\cos\alpha\]
\[\tan(\pi+\alpha)=\tan\alpha\]
如图\(2\),作\(P_1\)关于\(x\)轴的对称点\(P_3\),则以\(OP_3\)为终边的角为\(-\alpha\),并且有公式三\(:\)
\[\sin(-\alpha)=-\sin\alpha\]
\[\cos(-\alpha)=\cos\alpha\]
\[\tan(-\alpha)=-\tan\alpha\]
如图\(3\),作\(P_1\)关于\(y\)轴的对称点\(P_4\),则以\(OP_4\)为终边的角为\(\pi-\alpha\),并且有公式四\(:\)
\[\sin(\pi-\alpha)=\sin\alpha\]
\[\cos(\pi-\alpha)=-\cos\alpha\]
\[\tan(\pi-\alpha)=-\tan\alpha\]

方法点拨

利用公式一\(\sim\)公式四,可以把任意角的三角函数转化为锐角三角函数,一般可按下面步骤进行\(:\)

小结

(\(1\))记忆方法\(:\)\(2k\pi+\alpha(k\in\mathbf{Z})\),\(-\alpha\),\(\pi\pm\alpha\)的三角函数值等于\(\alpha\)的同名函数值,前面加上一个把\(\alpha\)看成锐角时原函数值的符号.
 
(\(2\))记忆口诀\(:“\)函数名不变,符号看象限\(”\).
 
(\(3\))诱导公式一\(\sim\)四的作用
公式一将负角\(、\)大于或等于\(2\pi\)的角的三角函数转化为\(0\sim2\pi\)的角的三角函数
公式二将\(\pi\sim2\pi\)的角的三角函数转化为\(0\sim\pi\)的角的三角函数
公式三若负角的三角函数转化为正角的三角函数
公式四将\(\dfrac{\pi}{2}\sim\pi\)的角的三角函数转化为\(0\sim\dfrac{\pi}{2}\)的角的三角函数

q.stem: 化简\(:\)\(\frac{\sin (\pi-\alpha)\cos (\frac{\pi}{2}+\alpha)\cos (\pi +\alpha)}{\sin (\frac{3\pi}{2}-\alpha)\cos (\frac{3\pi}{2}+\alpha)}=\) ________ .
